fields.machine_version_changelog:
Version: 2025.11.26
-------------------
NOTE: If you installed 11.24, your worm will not update again
      If you have NOT installed 11.24, that's fine - but see the 
      note on the 11.24 update below.
-------------------
- ADDED: New option to disable the fork "lift-release" entirely if that 
         works fine for your particular game.
- FIXED: Harvester final shot would set off the 'magnet release' noise too
         early if the ball bounced out of the opto beam and back (which
         happens most of the time)
- FIXED: If the 2nd half of Feyd's battle started with a shot to the right
         ramp, the magnet request to catch the ball on the left orbit would 
         remain until the end of the current ball.
- UPDATED: Hunter Seeker has an indication on the worm arrow when available.
- CHANGED: Lowest level on the volume adjustment is back to full mute, while
           preserving the adjustment range above that.
- CHANGED: The release bit of the "lift-release" on the fork holds just
           a bit longer.

Version 2025.11.24
-------------------
** IMPORTANT NOTE **********************************************
Due to updated worm board firmware in this build - after
the worm does it's initialization on first boot, you'll need to
use the Worm utility to adjust your "flush height" to make sure
the top of the worm is even with the playfield.
****************************************************************
- ADDED: Feyd Rautha's Arena Battle (Bene Gesserit award)
- ADDED: Hunter-Seeker - A side quest that starts with a shot
         through the harvester when a battle is not running.
- ADDED: New display for DUNE letter collect.
- ADDED: Small lightshow reaction on the playfield for harvester damage.
- ADDED: New feature setting for how long the (new) super jackpot timeout
         is in Desert Power
- ADDED: Callouts for remaining water as harvester battle nears timeout.
- ADDED: New feature setting to force scoop save back on during multiball.
- ADDED: New feature setting for extra ball after (X) Harvester wins.
- ADDED: Vanity Awards for Feyd and most Bene Gesserit awards.
- ADDED: On screen indication of how much the called worm cash out is.
- ADDED: Worm utility has visible indication of the worm mech optos.
- ADDED: New standard setting to disable shaker motor.
- ADDED: New coil setting for sand trap kicker pulse time.
- ADDED: New feature setting for bonus water/spice per new day/night
- ADDED: New feature setting for bonus spice per harvester defeated - this
         gets added to the playfield on the shots to collect.  If you 
         earn more than there is room for excess gets automatically 
         collected.
- ADDED: New audio setting for the line-out volume on the PC itself.
- ADDED: New sound effects for Jackpot build/Super Build in the battle
         arena for Desert power.
- ADDED: If a ball is detected on the battle arena lower switch for
         2 seconds when there's no trap set / no ball trapped, it will
         try again to lower the fork mech.
- ADDED: New PC "line out" volume setting.  Most people won't need to do
         anything with this, but if you're streaming and want to use the
         line out, you can turn it up now - AND if you're an audiophile
         and WANT to, you can crank the line out to 100% and adjust 
         the amp down to your liking.
- FIXED: Targets being down after Barrel Ball won't auto-award a thing.
- FIXED: Resetting with a sandsnork loaded would cause the item display
         to be incorrect on the next game start.
- FIXED: A hard shake to try to save on the way into pain box won't 
         confuse the trough and auto end the mode.
- FIXED: Force resetting the game could leave things in an odd state.
- FIXED: Fedaykin multiball didn't properly re-allow DUNE modes when ending.
- FIXED: Some errors with how "pending day" award data was stored.
- FIXED: The playfield screen background on Rescue would disappear.
- FIXED: Fight resets the combo length at the decision point now.
- FIXED: The ball search start callout could play when the search was 
		 actually prevented, so nothing happened.
- FIXED: Worm jackpot collect in the grace period would break.
- FIXED: If you started Liberate Arrakis with a ball in the sand trap
         and made it to the throne room with more than 1 ball still in
         play, mode would end as if drained.
- CHANGED: The harvester switch only triggers the orbit magnet if the 
           previous switch was the jump ramp - to avoid excess magnet
           activations if the harvester opto is acting up.
- CHANGED: Awaken's scoop shot also works from the back entry
- CHANGED: Bene Gesserit extra ball triggers the new Extra ball display.
- CHANGED: Destroying harvesters increases water capacity by 10.
- CHANGED: Fully completing prophecy mode increases spice capacity by 10.
- CHANGED: Desert Power super jackpot hold times out, adjustable with 
           a new feature setting.  If SJP times out, ball is released
           and regular jackpots are once again lit.
- CHANGED: Sand trap has a secondary check to make sure the balls all
           made it out on Fedaykin Multiball start.
- CHANGED: Coil/Switch/LED display names changed to sync up with manual.
- CHANGED: Harvester defense is now shown as a progress bar.
- CHANGED: A resumed Harvester battle is worth less points.
- CHANGED: Scoop eject ball save is disabled in multiball by default.
- CHANGED: Lasgun shot LEDs change to yellow/blue if they will be a kill shot.
- CHANGED: If more than one ball is in play and the battle arena bottom 
           switch is closed, ball search won't drop the fork.
- CHANGED: Sacrifice Jackpot is now straight 1 million per water remaining.
- CHANGED: In Train, the number of switch hits required in the battle
           arena was reduced.
- CHANGED: The Rescue spice jackpot awards as soon as the center worm
           opto is triggered, without waiting for the ball to settle.
- CHANGED: The color/text for the doubled shot in Survive phase 2
           was changed to separate it more clearly from Sandwalk
- CHANGED: Ball search is blocked if the game knows the coin door is open.
- CHANGED: Snork ball save time can be set to zero to disable if desired.
- CHANGED: DPMB "left turn" won't register if the last switch seen active
           was the shooter lane.
- CHANGED: The low end of the coin-door volume adjustment range was tweaked
		   to make the full range of adjustment more effective.
- UPDATED: Spice jackpot hurry-up is now extra spicy.
- UPDATED: Fedaykin Multiball uses a different music track.
- UPDATED: New version of the worm board firmware - will update on first
           boot and re-initialize the mech.  Has improved "home" secquence
           and better status reporting.
- UPDATED: Scoring changed throughout for balance
- UPDATED: Sandwalk Jackpots have some changes.
           - Scoring increased.
           - Once sandwalk is lit on the side ramp it stays lit 
             until you shoot the side ramp to start it.
           - You can continue to the sandwalk to build value with 
             the left orbit magnet catch and more side ramp shots;
             other shots (combo or not) do not build the value.
- UPDATED: Barrel Ball got some refining.  If desired, you can set
           a number of players now, so the game will end on it's own.
           Also, there's "how to play" text on the screen after the 
           intro, clearer messaging on what to do when playing, and
           the game starts with 1 red shot lit.

Update instructions - Games connected to Stern Insider Connected:
1 - Open the coin door and press the black/enter button to enter Test Mode.
2 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate to the Stern Insider Connected Setup menu.
3 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate down to the Software Update menu.
4 - If a software update is available, this page will give you the option to
    download and install it manually.  From this menu you can also select to install these
    updates automatically.

Update instructions - All Games:
1 - Download the zip file
2 - Unzip the file, this will create a folder that contains SPK file(s).
3 - Open the folder, copy the file(s) to the root level of a FAT32 formatted
    USB stick.  (Do not copy the folder.)
4 - Power game off
5 - Insert USB stick
6 - Turn on game
7 - After game boots up it will give the option for software update
8 - Volume buttons change options for full or quick update. Enter selects the
    option and starts the update.
9 - Once update is completed game will prompt user to power game off and
    remove USB stick.

==============================================
V1.02.0 - All Game Release - July 1, 2026
==============================================
- Jaws: The Revenge
   - Fix an issue where Defeating Quint achievement would not be reported.
   - swapping WEST <-> EAST beach text labels in the eating mode. They now match the playfield.

- Search Multiball
   - At long last, you can now skip the intro with both flipper buttons.
    
- Life Ring
   - Use Life Ring Difficulty - EASY was never setting a grace period. Now 3/4 seconds.
   - Prevent left outlane switch from auto consuming life ring when the grace period is active.

- Super Cast 'N Catch
   - Fix an issue where this mode is advertised on the Lef Ramp when it isn't truly available.
     For example, due to some other wizard mode running.
    
- DJ Mixer
   - Added wizard modes music under the "NEW MUSIC FOR CASUALS" playlist.
   - Added a new playlist of the music that never made it into the game "CUTTING ROOM FLOOR".

- System Version 4.28
   - Nodeboard firmware/protocol v1.33.0
   - Now uses Graphical Service Menu with added features, adjustments, audits, and tests.
   - Added support for ToPS tournament in the Game Play Menu
   - Added support for Service Menu Diagnostics Tests to take switches/LEDs Out of Service/Return to Service.
   - Utilities Save/Load Menus now support local save slots for saving/restoring.
       If no USB drive is present, pressing ENTER will save to or load from the internal SD card.
       5 unique save slots are available.
   - Various behind the scenes improvements for correctness and performance.

   - Increased switch scoring for playing Say Ah! from 15K to 50K

=======================================================
V1.00.0 - JAWS 50th Anniversary Update - July 2nd, 2025
=======================================================
- Jaws Anniversary Premium Edition - Added support for this new game model.

- Smile you son of a... 
    - Added this new final wizard mode.
    - Light this mode at the Center Ramp by playing Jaws Multiball Part 3
    - Selection screen allows a choice of playing the "Smile you son of a..." or "Keep Chumming" to complete other objectives first.
    - Single ball, timed 60 seconds (default)
    - The final showdown move through all 3 phases to reach the end of the movie:
       - Phase 1: Quint's Demise
       - Phase 2: Clash on the Mast
       - Phase 3: Smile you son of a...
    - Each phase has several shots to hit and ends with a hurry up shot:
       - Hurry up value is based off the time remaining.
       - Collecting the hurry up also adds 30 seconds.
    - To retry the mode after losing, complete the chumline to light at the Center Ramp again.
    - Winning this mode starts Super Celebration Multiball and ends the game when it is complete.

- Super Celebration Multiball 
    - Added this final victory mode that plays after completing "Smile you son of a..."
    - 6 balls, limited ball saver.
    - All main shots are lit for Jackpots.
    - Shooting Jackpots unlights that shot.

                              - Shoot a beach shot to move the shark to that beach.
                              - Swimmers can take a few Action Button presses before they are eaten.
                              - The more swimmers are eaten, the more increase to the Growth meter.

fields.machine_comments:
Star Wars: Fall of the Empire was announced on September 12, 2025, nearly 48 years after the original Star Wars premiered in theaters.
The game was designed by John Borg, who also designed Stern's original Star Wars (2017).
The Limited Edition production quantity was set at 770 units at launch as a tribute to the original film's 1977 release.
The game debuted Stern's next-generation SPIKE 3 platform, introducing a larger 18.5-inch full-HD display and redesigned electronics.
Actor Chris Bartlett recorded original dialogue as C-3PO. Bartlett has portrayed multiple characters in live-action Star Wars productions.
The official C-3PO topper is compatible with both Star Wars: Fall of the Empire (2025) and Stern's Star Wars (2017).
The C-3PO topper unlocks an exclusive Escape Bespin challenge mode not available without the accessory.
The game's physical mechanisms recreate famous scenes from the original trilogy, including bringing down an AT-AT on Hoth, escaping Cloud City aboard the Millennium Falcon, and attacking the second Death Star.
Software updates expanded the ruleset after release, adding cooperative play, team play, additional Force Missions, and the "Never Tell Me the Odds" mini-wizard mode.
fields.machine_ornament: An officially licensed C-3PO animatronic topper was released by Stern Pinball in December 2025 as an optional accessory for the Pro, Premium, and LE models. The topper features a sculpted C-3PO head with motorized movement, integrated RGB lighting, and s
fields.machine_videomode: No traditional standalone video mode has been confirmed. The game uses Stern's 18.5-inch full-HD SPIKE 3 display to present film footage, custom animations, scoring information, and interactive mission progress during gameplay. Screen-based sequences accompany major events, including Death Star Multiball, Battle of Hoth, Darth Vader modes, and Millennium Falcon missions. These sequences are integrated into physical pinball gameplay rather than functioning as independent video modes.

fields.machine_toys:
Stern SPIKE 3 platform with 18.5-inch full-HD LCD display, enhanced audio, and integrated Insider Connected.
Designed by John Borg, with software development by Andrew Wilkening and Raymond Davidson.
Original Star Wars trilogy theme featuring characters and events from Episodes IV, V, and VI.
Custom sculpted AT-AT walker surrounded by a spiral ramp, with motorized movement on Premium and LE models.
Interactive Death Star II mechanism used during Death Star Multiball.
Millennium Falcon-themed gameplay featuring Hyperspace ramps and escape sequences.
Motorized Hyperspace lift ramp on Premium and LE models.
Jedi Save magnetic ball-save mechanism on Premium and LE models.
Jabba the Hutt sculpt and Sarlacc Pit ball-spinning mechanism.
Multiple multiball modes, including Death Star, Battle of Hoth, Lightspeed, and Dark Side.
Darth Vader modes, Force Missions, and character-based objectives.
Over 1,000 film and audio assets, including original movie footage and John Williams' musical score.
Custom C-3PO dialogue performed by actor Chris Bartlett.
Optional animatronic C-3PO topper featuring synchronized movement, lighting, and an exclusive Escape Bespin challenge mode.
Cooperative and team-play options added through software updates.
Limited Edition restricted to 770 units at launch, featuring mirrored backglass, upgraded audio, Expression Lighting, shaker motor, anti-reflective glass, and exclusive cabinet appointments.
fields.machine_comments:
Star Wars: Fall of the Empire was announced on September 12, 2025, nearly 48 years after the original Star Wars premiered in theaters.
The game was designed by John Borg, who also designed Stern's original Star Wars (2017).
The Limited Edition production quantity was set at 770 units at launch as a tribute to the original film's 1977 release.
The game debuted Stern's next-generation SPIKE 3 platform, introducing a larger 18.5-inch full-HD display and redesigned electronics.
Actor Chris Bartlett recorded original dialogue as C-3PO. Bartlett has portrayed multiple characters in live-action Star Wars productions.
The official C-3PO topper is compatible with both Star Wars: Fall of the Empire (2025) and Stern's Star Wars (2017).
The C-3PO topper unlocks an exclusive Escape Bespin challenge mode not available without the accessory.
The game's physical mechanisms recreate famous scenes from the original trilogy, including bringing down an AT-AT on Hoth, escaping Cloud City aboard the Millennium Falcon, and attacking the second Death Star.
Software updates expanded the ruleset after release, adding cooperative play, team play, additional Force Missions, and the "Never Tell Me the Odds" mini-wizard mode.
fields.machine_ornament: An officially licensed C-3PO animatronic topper was released by Stern Pinball in December 2025 as an optional accessory for the Pro, Premium, and LE models. The topper features a sculpted C-3PO head with motorized movement, integrated RGB lighting, and s
fields.machine_videomode: No traditional standalone video mode has been confirmed. The game uses Stern's 18.5-inch full-HD SPIKE 3 display to present film footage, custom animations, scoring information, and interactive mission progress during gameplay. Screen-based sequences accompany major events, including Death Star Multiball, Battle of Hoth, Darth Vader modes, and Millennium Falcon missions. These sequences are integrated into physical pinball gameplay rather than functioning as independent video modes.

fields.machine_toys:
Stern SPIKE 3 platform with 18.5-inch full-HD LCD display, enhanced audio, and integrated Insider Connected.
Designed by John Borg, with software development by Andrew Wilkening and Raymond Davidson.
Original Star Wars trilogy theme featuring characters and events from Episodes IV, V, and VI.
Custom sculpted AT-AT walker surrounded by a spiral ramp, with motorized movement on Premium and LE models.
Interactive Death Star II mechanism used during Death Star Multiball.
Millennium Falcon-themed gameplay featuring Hyperspace ramps and escape sequences.
Motorized Hyperspace lift ramp on Premium and LE models.
Jedi Save magnetic ball-save mechanism on Premium and LE models.
Jabba the Hutt sculpt and Sarlacc Pit ball-spinning mechanism.
Multiple multiball modes, including Death Star, Battle of Hoth, Lightspeed, and Dark Side.
Darth Vader modes, Force Missions, and character-based objectives.
Over 1,000 film and audio assets, including original movie footage and John Williams' musical score.
Custom C-3PO dialogue performed by actor Chris Bartlett.
Optional animatronic C-3PO topper featuring synchronized movement, lighting, and an exclusive Escape Bespin challenge mode.
Cooperative and team-play options added through software updates.
Limited Edition restricted to 770 units at launch, featuring mirrored backglass, upgraded audio, Expression Lighting, shaker motor, anti-reflective glass, and exclusive cabinet appointments.
fields.machine_comments:
Star Wars: Fall of the Empire was announced on September 12, 2025, nearly 48 years after the original Star Wars premiered in theaters.
The game was designed by John Borg, who also designed Stern's original Star Wars (2017).
The Limited Edition production quantity was set at 770 units at launch as a tribute to the original film's 1977 release.
The game debuted Stern's next-generation SPIKE 3 platform, introducing a larger 18.5-inch full-HD display and redesigned electronics.
Actor Chris Bartlett recorded original dialogue as C-3PO. Bartlett has portrayed multiple characters in live-action Star Wars productions.
The official C-3PO topper is compatible with both Star Wars: Fall of the Empire (2025) and Stern's Star Wars (2017).
The C-3PO topper unlocks an exclusive Escape Bespin challenge mode not available without the accessory.
The game's physical mechanisms recreate famous scenes from the original trilogy, including bringing down an AT-AT on Hoth, escaping Cloud City aboard the Millennium Falcon, and attacking the second Death Star.
Software updates expanded the ruleset after release, adding cooperative play, team play, additional Force Missions, and the "Never Tell Me the Odds" mini-wizard mode.
fields.machine_ornament: An officially licensed C-3PO animatronic topper was released by Stern Pinball in December 2025 as an optional accessory for the Pro, Premium, and LE models. The topper features a sculpted C-3PO head with motorized movement, integrated RGB lighting, and s
fields.machine_videomode: No traditional standalone video mode has been confirmed. The game uses Stern's 18.5-inch full-HD SPIKE 3 display to present film footage, custom animations, scoring information, and interactive mission progress during gameplay. Screen-based sequences accompany major events, including Death Star Multiball, Battle of Hoth, Darth Vader modes, and Millennium Falcon missions. These sequences are integrated into physical pinball gameplay rather than functioning as independent video modes.

fields.machine_toys:
Revolving Hallway Turntable: Motorized assembly featuring three entrances and eight positions that dynamically changes available shot paths as players explore the mansion.
Winchester Mystery House Ghost Box: Interactive Pepper's Ghost illusion using a secondary LCD display to create supernatural apparitions that appear to occupy physical space above the playfield.
Collapsing Tower: Motorized tower that falls during gameplay, revealing a hidden ball path inspired by the 1906 San Francisco earthquake.
Staircase to Nowhere: Magnetic ball catch that temporarily holds and releases the ball, recreating one of the mansion's famous architectural oddities.
Door to Nowhere: Elevated staircase ramp that sends balls through the mansion's network of passages.
Right Staircase Ramp: Elevated ramp featuring three possible exits.
Séance Room: Three inline drop targets guard the entrance to a physical three-ball locking mechanism beneath an illuminated crystal ball.
Spirit Board Apron: Interactive illuminated spirit board featuring a moving-light oracle, player information, ball-lock indicators, countdown timers, and a left outlane kickback.
Horizon Atmospheric Lighting: Integrated lighting system that enhances the game's supernatural atmosphere and provides visual feedback during gameplay.
Mansion Exploration: Players select destinations and navigate the mansion, building scoring opportunities while traveling between rooms and completing supernatural challenges.
Angry Spirits: Failed room modes release hostile spirits that can interrupt exploration through Spirit Battles, Ambushes, and Reckonings.
Thirteens: Five separate objectives built around the number 13, each unlocking a unique mini-mode. Completing the objectives provides access to the Thirteenths wizard mode.
Mementos: Collectible supernatural artifacts earned through completing rooms and other objectives, providing gameplay benefits and progression.
Multiple Multiballs: Includes Séance Multiball and Wheelbarrow Ghost Multiball, featuring interactive physical mechanisms and themed objectives.
Four Flippers: Two main flippers and two additional playfield flippers provide access to the game's complex network of ramps and passages.
Custom Sculptures: Detailed representations of the Witch's Cap, mansion roofline, tower, stained-glass window frame, and séance crystal ball.
fields.machine_comments:
Winchester Mystery House was officially announced on October 13, 2025, shortly before the 2025 Chicago Pinball Expo.
The game was designed by Karl DeAngelo, better known in the competitive pinball community as IE Pinball. It represents his debut as a commercial pinball designer.
Production was limited to 525 machines, a reference to 525 South Winchester Boulevard, the street address of the actual Winchester Mystery House in San Jose, California.
Barrels of Fun confirmed that the production run would remain limited to the originally announced 525 machines.
The game is officially licensed from the Winchester Mystery House, a historic California landmark and former residence of Sarah Winchester, widow of William Wirt Winchester.
Construction on the real Winchester Mystery House continued from 1886 until Sarah Winchester's death in 1922, a period of approximately 36 years.
The mansion's unusual architecture, including doors opening onto walls or empty space and staircases leading nowhere, directly inspired several of the game's mechanical features.
The game's collapsing tower references the 1906 San Francisco earthquake, which damaged portions of the original mansion.
Original artwork was created by Brad Albright, with music, sound design, and voice-over direction by Jeff Dodson, also known as Dirty Pool.
The game uses the FAST Pinball control platform rather than Stern's SPIKE system or Jersey Jack's proprietary electronics.
The Thirteenths wizard mode was added through a software update released February 19, 2026.
The April 2026 software update introduced the Echoes wizard mode, Angry Spirits, and the Daisy Bedroom.
The October 1, 2026 software update expanded the mansion with the Witch's Cap and Servant's Callroom modes.
fields.machine_ornament: No factory backbox ornament or topper was included with Winchester Mystery House, and no official topper has been confirmed. The game features an illuminated backbox presentation with decorative speaker grilles inspired by stained-glass windows. Barrels o
fields.machine_videomode: No traditional standalone video mode has been documented for Winchester Mystery House. The game uses its primary LCD and secondary Ghost Box display for animated sequences, supernatural encounters, mansion exploration, and interactive gameplay. These elements are integrated into physical pinball play rather than operating as separate video-only modes.

fields.machine_toys:
Motorized, player-controlled crossbow mechanism that fires pinballs across the playfield
Interactive Cell Block C prison building with mechanically operated doors and an enclosed Walker bash target
Prison playfield magnet that captures and releases the ball during gameplay
Animated Well Walker bash toy with integrated magnetic ball interaction
Bicycle Girl ramp with mechanically operated entrance that exposes a hidden bash target
Illuminated sculpted zombie heads on the slingshots
Four-bank drop targets used to qualify Dead Feature modes
Five Dead Feature modes: Barn, CDC, Riot, Tunnel, and Arena
Prison, Well Walker, and Blood Bath multiballs
Last Man Standing wizard mode requiring 115 Walker kills
Escape Terminus, Horde, Siege, and Crossbow Frenzy modes
Flamethrower spinner and associated jackpot scoring
Dynamic shot multiplier system that increases through consecutive Walker kills
Full-color RGB playfield lighting
SPIKE 3 electronics with an 18.5-inch full-HD LCD display
New 3D-rendered animations inspired by the original game's dot-matrix presentation
New custom callouts from Michael Rooker as Merle Dixon and Danai Gurira as Michonne
Stern Insider Connected integration for achievements and player tracking
fields.machine_comments:
The Walking Dead Remastered was announced November 4, 2025, more than a decade after the original 2014 Stern release.
The remaster was developed under the direction of original game designer John Borg.
The game preserves and updates the influential original ruleset developed by the late Lyman F. Sheats Jr.
Unlike the 2014 release, the remastered version is available only in Premium and Limited Edition configurations, with no Pro model.
Only 500 Limited Edition machines were produced for the global market.
The Limited Edition features an individually autographed game component signed by John Borg.
The Limited Edition includes a Certificate of Authenticity signed by Stern President and CEO Seth Davis.
Robert Laskey created new hand-painted-style artwork for the remastered cabinet and backglass.
Actors Michael Rooker and Danai Gurira recorded custom dialogue reprising their roles as Merle Dixon and Michonne.
The game is based on AMC's television adaptation of The Walking Dead, which premiered in 2010 and originated from the comic book series created by Robert Kirkman and Tony Moore.
The remaster introduces an 18.5-inch full-HD LCD and SPIKE 3 hardware to a design originally released with a dot-matrix display.
The Premium and Limited Edition versions share the same primary playfield mechanisms and gameplay layout.
fields.machine_ornament: Premium: Full-color translite featuring new artwork by Robert Laskey. Optional Governor's Fish Tank Topper: An interactive topper inspired by the original 2014 release. Features a larger aquarium-style enclosure, redesigned zombie heads

============================================================
V0.94 - A Walker's Treat - October 21st, 2026
============================================================

-Added new Woodbury Skill Shot.
	-Replaces old Woodbury Skill Shot.
	-Original Woodbury Skill Shot can be accessed using the Classic adjustment.
	-How to play:
		-Start Woodbury Skill Shot by hitting/lowering the right drop target and entering Woodbury.
		-Score points in the Top Lanes. The Right Top Lane scores double the Left Top Lane.
		-Hit lit Rollover Buttons precisely to earn Mystery Awards instead.
		-Light Rollover Buttons by hitting Pop Bumpers. This raises the Rollover Button's Mystery Award Level.
		-Use Flipper Buttons to lower or restore your Rollover Button's Mystery Award Level.
		-Avoid the Tower Target!

-Added a Crossbow motor calibration test to the test menu.
-Added next shot value and progress to the Prison Multiball background screen.
-Added next shot score value text to the Riot background screen.
-Added an adjustment to limit the number of Rescues per game.
-Added an adjustment to control whether Walker Bombs can start a Multiball.
-Added Total Title text to the Bicycle Girl total screen.
-Added Instant Info pages for Supplies, Tilt Warnings, and Woodbury.
-Updated the Walker Bomb multiball adjustment to be in Game Play Settings/Walkers, and the Prison Magnet delay to be in Machine Settings/Coil Settings.
-Updated Escape! Outlane Ball Save to be awarded on every other First Aid completion.
-Updated Last Man Standing so it can be lit during Crossbow Frenzy and Fish Tank Frenzy.
-Updated Last Man Standing to limit balls in play to 4.
-Updated Fish Tank Frenzy so it can no longer stack with multiballs, wizard modes, or Crossbow Frenzy.
-Updated Woodbury to light after 2 right drop target hits.
-Updated Prison doors to open after a slight delay when Prison Attack starts.
-Updated Crossbow Frenzy award flasher effect to be shorter.
-Updated Well Walker Multiball so more hits are needed to earn a WELL letter.
-Updated Horde music and sound volumes to be louder.
-Updated GI light level maximums.
-Updated Prison Walker head and Bicycle Girl head to register on switch hit instead of switch release.
-Updated Crossbow Frenzy and Horde background screens to improve memory usage.
-Fixed an issue where the Action button would light when Walker/Prison Bomb isn't available.
-Fixed Bonus Held being increased by bonus multipliers.
-Fixed an issue where the Blood Bath Multiball total screen text was not displaying correctly.
-Fixed an issue in Crossbow Frenzy where a walker respawned at the left orbit could not be hit for score.
-Fixed an issue in Crossbow Frenzy where the timer disappeared while active.
-Fixed an issue where the Crossbow didn't home properly on power-up.
-Fixed an issue where completing Weapons was not increasing Crossbow score.
-Fixed an issue where the Bit multiplier was never being applied.
-Fixed an issue where drop target Supply awards were not increasing scores in Prison Multiball, Well Attack and Well Multiball.
-Fixed an issue where the spinner lamp/sound effects slowed the game.
-Fixed an issue where escaping in Horde auto-plunged the ball instead of allowing a skill shot.
-Fixed an issue where Siege allowed Crossbow Frenzy and Fish Tank Frenzy to advance and start.
-Fixed an issue where Horde walkers were not advancing as close to the player as they should.
-Fixed an issue where a Horde video was missing.
-Fixed an issue where playfield multipliers and mode timers were not pausing during Woodbury.
-Fixed an issue in Prison Attack where an award was labeled incorrectly.
-Fixed a Tilt Warning Remaining typo.

System V4.40 Update
-Updated to nodeboard firmware/protocol v1.41.0
-Various behind the scenes improvements for correctness and performance.

============================================================
V0.93 - All Walkers Release - June 29th, 2026
============================================================

-Added Escape! outlane ball save. This can be lit in Woodbury, from First Aid, or from Tower targets.
-Added Bonus Held award. This can be earned deeper in the Woodbury awards.
-Added new Bonus screen. This includes Bonus Held and other game features that now add to players' bonus score.
-Updated Classic game adjustment to handle all new remastered rules in this update. Classic adjustment is defaulted off now.
-Updated scoring for Crossbow Frenzy to include any Crossbow shots made during the frenzy will enhance the final award.
-Updated base final award score in Crossbow Frenzy to be lower, due to the enhancements from Crossbow shots above.
-Updated CDC scoring to be less exploitable. Now all extra CDC shots (Riot, Tunnel, Barn, and Arena) add a flat 2.5 million bonus to the final CDC award, instead of the full award value. This comes with a separate adjustment to turn the larger bonuses back on and is also affected by the Classic adjustment.
-Updated Walker Bombs so they can no longer directly start a Multiball. This can be changed in adjustments.
-Updated the High Score table defaults.
-Fixed an issue where action button presses were awarding on both press and release. This also fixes Walker Bombs being awarded on ball launch at ball start.
-Fixed an issue where Crossbow Frenzy ready did not reset correctly game to game if a game ended with Crossbow Frenzy in the ready state.
-Fixed an issue where Crossbow shots would not end when the crossbow would force eject at the end of its travel.
-Fixed an issue where timer wasn't showing on UI in Crossbow Frenzy.
-Fixed an issue where Replay, Bump 'N Win, and other related awards did not show the UI.

System V4.28 Update
- Fixed error when configuring "Award Tickets for Score?" in redemption settings fixed.
- Utilities Save/Load Menus now support local save slots for saving/restoring.
       If no USB drive is present, pressing ENTER will save to or load from the internal SD card.
       5 unique save slots are available.
-Various behind the scenes improvements for correctness and performance.

============================================================
V0.92 - Nock 'em Dead - June 1st, 2026
============================================================

-Added New Crossbow Frenzy Mode.
	-Updated Crossbow Frenzy with enhanced rules, graphics, sound, and speech.
	-How to Play:
		-Start by completing all Crossbow shots.
		-Hit lit walkers before they reach you.
		-Hit walkers with the crossbow to greatly increase scoring and slow down respawn time.
		-Survive by staying alive until the timer runs out.
		-Win by eliminating all lit walkers before they finish respawning.
		-Achieve a perfect bonus by winning without getting bitten.

-Added new IC achievements for Horde and Crossbow Frenzy.
-Updated DJ mixer to show volume and pause text notifications.
-Updated High Score X Champion to show additional information about how the X was achieved.
-Updated Fish Tank Frenzy scoring boosts from completing the Fish Tank to be higher.
-Updated Fish Tank Frenzy max scoring potential.
-Updated general switch scores to be higher.
-Fixed an issue in Fish Tank Frenzy where shot multipliers brought into the mode wouldn't give the multiplied score correctly.
-Removed some debug adjustments that were accidentally showing.

System V4.26 Update
-Utilities Save/Load Menus now support local save slots for saving/restoring. If no USB drive is present, pressing ENTER will save to or load from the SD card. 5 unique save slots are available.
-Various behind the scenes improvements for correctness and performance.

============================================================

============================================================

-Added Fish Tank Frenzy.
	-Fish Tank Topper exclusive mode!
	-Start by completing three fish tanks and then entering Woodbury.
	-Hit lit shots to collect a head for the fish tank.
	-Collect three heads to light Woodbury again for Super Jackpot.
	-Increase your award with a Multiplier skill shot.
	
-Added DJ Mixer to the player menu.
-Added ToPs tournament feature to the player menu.
-Fixed an issue with Walker Kills lighting up the wrong shot.
-Fixed an issue in Well Walker Multiball where the magnet would activate on switch hits, rather than when Well Walker shot was active.
-Fixed an issue in Well Walker Multiball during victory laps where the next jackpot score would not show correctly in the background.
-Fixed an issue in player menu where it was not defaulting selections correctly.

System V4.25 Update
-Added support for ToPS tournament in the Game Play Menu.
-Added "Test Menu Settings" to the "Machine Settings" category in the Graphical Service Menu. This allows customization of test screen colors, lamp test RGB behavior, and the starting menu. selection.
-Updated to nodeboard firmware/protocol v1.33.0.
-Various behind the scenes improvements for correctness and performance.

============================================================
V0.90 - Talking Dead - March 12th, 2026
============================================================

-Added Michonne custom speech.
-Added Walking Dead TV show speech.
-Added Horde display scenes.
-Added new High Score Enter Initials display scene.
-Added additional Siege award display scenes.
-Added Prison Multiball Ready display scene.
-Added default score to Bonus screen. Bonus screen will now show at the end of every ball, even if no walkers have been collected that ball.
-Added new sound FXs.
-Updated several display scene texts.
-Updated several fonts.
-Updated sound balance.
-Fixed Well Walker Multiball advance well lights.
-Fixed an issue where the bicycle girl ramp would re-open after the ball launched when missing a crossbow show that ended up directly in the trough during a ball save.
-Fixed an incorrect background display video for Tunnel.
-Fixed an issue where Player Up call out would play during the ending of Last Man Standing.
-Fixed an incorrect flasher going off during Prison Multiball advance.
-Fixed various text alignments and outlines.

System V4.19 Update
-Various behind the scenes improvements for correctness and performance.

============================================================
V0.81 - I Chews You! - February 11th, 2026
============================================================

-Added IC achievements.
-Added Champion Screens to Attract Mode.
-Added new display screens for Siege, Last Man Standing, and Terminus.
-Added Arena Feature completed screen.
-Added additional Skill Shot crossbow and shotgun scenes.
-Added Well Walker Multiball Ready light and flasher effect.
-Added Prison Multiball and Well Walker Multiball background text.
-Added additional Speech and Sound FX throughout the game.
-Updated UI screen text, score highlighting for Match, and Double Scoring animation.
-Updated Woodbury Skill Shot award to have 5 award options available, matching the number of available switches.
-Updated all Feature and Multiball total screens.
-Updated Multikill award screens.
-Updated Skill Shot award screens.
-Updated Bicycle Girl background text.
-Updated Match behavior.
-Updated Food supply screen.
-Updated Shaker Motor behavior for Tunnel Feature.
-Updated existing fonts and texts for awards and instructions.
-Updated Attract Mode screens for Game Over, Player Scores, Replay, and additional messaging.
-Updated Service Menu to games without tournament buttons properly.
-Updated Music, Speech, and Sound FX volumes throughout the game.
-Updated Prison flashers to now alternate flashing between interior red and white when Prison Attack starts.
-Updated Service Menu messages for coin mechs.
-Updated several fonts.
-Fixed an issue in Fish Tank award screen where it may show the incorrect amount of heads in the tank.
-Fixed an issue in Barn Feature where award light shows were not showing correctly.
-Fixed an issue in Woodbury Skill Shot where it would show an incorrect award if the player missed their shot.
-Fixed an issue where ball search would give awards relating to Prison and Well Walker.
-Fixed an issue with Pop Bumper Jackpot award where it would persist inappropriately.
-Fixed a cabinet light issue where it might stop updating under certain conditions.
-Fixed Right Single Drop Target behavior in the Service Menu.
-Fixed Service Menu messages for sound/speaker test speech.
-Fixed an issue where mechanical devices didn't always reset properly after boot up.
-Removed Well Walker Coil Hold Power adjustment. This was not being used.

System V4.17 Update

-Updated to nodeboard firmware/protocol v1.31.0
-Spike 3 netbridge 0.98.4
-Various behind the scenes improvements for correctness and performance.

============================================================
V0.80 - Holiday Bites - December 22nd, 2025
============================================================

-Added new and updated display artwork throughout the game.
-Added new and updated sound effects and speech throughout the game.
-Added new background and award light shows.
-Added new accessory topper, speaker, cabinet, and shooter light shows.
-Added shaker motor functionality.
-Added visual mode timer on the UI.
-Added power adjustments for flippers, pop bumpers, auto fire, coil power, and device disables.
-Modified speech and sound fx volumes.
-Fixed missing music on modes.
-Fixed some improper usage of old speech calls.
-Fixed rare hang to power on.

Update instructions - Games connected to Stern Insider Connected:
1 - Open the coin door and press the black/enter button to enter Test Mode.
2 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate to the Stern Insider Connected Setup menu.
3 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate down to the Software Update menu.
4 - If a software update is available, this page will give you the option to
    download and install it manually.  From this menu you can also select to install these
    updates automatically.

Update instructions - All Games:
1 - Download the zip file
2 - Unzip the file, this will create a folder that contains SPK file(s).
3 - Open the folder, copy the file(s) to the root level of a FAT32 formatted
    USB stick.  (Do not copy the folder.)
4 - Power game off
5 - Insert USB stick
6 - Turn on game
7 - After game boots up it will give the option for software update
8 - Volume buttons change options for full or quick update. Enter selects the
    option and starts the update.
9 - Once update is completed game will prompt user to power game off and
    remove USB stick.

                        - Shoot the Quickshot gate when the Yellow insert is lit to raise the shark's health meter.

                    - Phase 1 - EAT SWIMMERS
                              - The 5 main beach shots will have swimmers that can be eaten using the Action Button.
                              - Shoot a beach shot to move the shark to that beach.
                              - Swimmers can take a few Action Button presses before they are eaten.
                              - The more swimmers are eaten, the more increase to the Growth meter.
                              - Fill the Growth meter to level up your shark after completing Phase 2.
                              - Eat consecutive swimmers without taking damage to raise the Streak multiplier.
                              - Shoot the Chum Bucket when lit to spawn a random swimmer. 
                              - Fishing Boats:
                                    - will appear beach shots as Teal arrows.
                                    - takes 1 shot to destroy them.
                                    - throws 2 fisherman into the water when destroyed.
                              - Police Boats:
                                    - will appear beach shots as Red/Blue arrows.
                                    - will save all swimmers at that beach.
                                    - will keep the beaches closed from any more swimmers.
                                    - will attack shark and lower the health meter ever few seconds when shark is at the same beach.
                                    - takes 2 shots to destroy them.
                                    - once destroyed the beaches are opened and the beach is filled with swimmers.
                              - Each boat destroyed will raise the shark's health meter.
                              - Once you eat enough swimmers a Bounty will be placed on you and time will expire on this Phase.

                    - Phase 2 - BOUNTY HUNTER
                              - Shoot the Boat/Shark Cage to attack Bounty Hunter and drain his meter.
                              - Green arrows light for 1X damage and combos can be shot for 2X damage.
                              - Bounty Hunter will attach a barrel ever few seconds he is alive.
                              - Barrels have the following penalties:
                                    - 1 Barrel - Swimmers take twice as many chomps to eat in the "EAT SWIMMERS" phase.
                                    - 2 Barrels - Shark cannot Heal.
                                    - 3 Barrels - Shark Health meter is drained every few seconds.
                              - Leveling up your Shark will remove all attached Barrels.
                              - Defeating a Bounty Hunter will remove a single attached Barrel.
                              - Drain the Bounty Hunter's meter all the way to light a final shot at the Boat/Shark Cage.
                              - Higher levels require you to face more than one Bounty Hunter.

                    - Phase 3 - BONUS
                              - Collect a bonus point value for each Swimmer and Boat that was destroyed for this level.
                              - When your Growth meter is full your shark levels up now and resets until you reach Great White.
                              - Shark Levels:
                                    - Mako - 6 chomps per swimmer
                                    - Thresher - 5 chomps per swimmer
                                    - Hammerhead - 4 chomps per swimmer
                                    - Tiger - 3 chomps per swimmer
                                    - Great White - 2 chomps per swimmer

                    - Phase 4 - SHARK ALLEY
                              - Use Left or Right flipper buttons to chomp swimmers.
                              - Don't chomp fellow sharks.
                              - Don't wait too long or time will run out.

                    - Power Up - Shoot lit 3-Bank Targets to light a roving Shark Tower Standup Target to begin a Power up for a limited period.
                               - Powered Up perks:
                                    - Shark becomes invincible.
                                    - Swimmers can be eaten with one chomp.
                                    - Bounty Hunters take 2X damage from all shots.

                    - Play through multiple levels of increasing difficulty until all lives are lost.
                    - Each eaten swimmer contributes to the Shark Bounty Value.

Update instructions - Games connected to Stern Insider Connected:
1 - Open the coin door and press the black/enter button to enter Test Mode.
2 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate to the Stern Insider Connected Setup menu.
3 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate down to the Software Update menu.
4 - If a software update is available, this page will give you the option to
    download and install it manually.  From this menu you can also select to install these
    updates automatically.

Update instructions - All Games:
1 - Download the zip file
2 - Unzip the file, this will create a folder that contains SPK file(s).
3 - Open the folder, copy the file(s) to the root level of a FAT32 formatted
    USB stick.  (Do not copy the folder.)
4 - Power game off
5 - Insert USB stick
6 - Turn on game
7 - After game boots up it will give the option for software update
8 - Volume buttons change options for full or quick update. Enter selects the
    option and starts the update.
9 - Once update is completed game will prompt user to power game off and
    remove USB stick.

Update instructions - Games connected to Stern Insider Connected:
1 - Open the coin door and press the black/enter button to enter Test Mode.
2 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate to the Stern Insider Connected Setup menu.
3 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate down to the Software Update menu.

    download and install it manually.  From this menu you can also select to install these
    updates automatically.

Update instructions - All Games:
1 - Download the zip file
2 - Unzip the file, this will create a folder that contains SPK file(s).
3 - Open the folder, copy the file(s) to the root level of a FAT32 formatted
    USB stick.  (Do not copy the folder.)
4 - Power game off
5 - Insert USB stick
6 - Turn on game
7 - After game boots up it will give the option for software update
8 - Volume buttons change options for full or quick update. Enter selects the
    option and starts the update.
9 - Once update is completed game will prompt user to power game off and
    remove USB stick.

- Jaws: The Revenge - Added this challenge mode which is available on the Game Mode menu as an option to play

                        - Each ball drained will lower meter.
                        - Once meter is empty your shark dies and you lose a life (ball). Play moves onto the next life (ball).
                        - Shoot the Quickshot gate when the Yellow insert is lit to raise the shark's health meter.
                        - Shoot the Ship Wheel spinner on the upper playfield to raise the shark's health meter.

                    - Phase 1 - EAT SWIMMERS
                              - The 5 main beach shots will have swimmers that can be eaten using the Action Button.
                              - Shoot a beach shot to move the shark to that beach.
                              - Swimmers can take a few Action Button presses before they are eaten.
                              - The more swimmers are eaten, the more increase to the Growth meter.
                              - Fill the Growth meter to level up your shark after completing Phase 2.
                              - Eat consecutive swimmers without taking damage to raise the Streak multiplier.
                              - Shoot the Chum Bucket when lit to spawn a random swimmer. 
                              - Shoot the Upper Playfield ramp when lit Orange to spawn all swimmers.
                              - Fishing Boats:
                                    - will appear beach shots as Teal arrows.
                                    - takes 1 shot to destroy them.
                                    - throws 2 fisherman into the water when destroyed.
                              - Police Boats:
                                    - will appear beach shots as Red/Blue arrows.
                                    - will save all swimmers at that beach.
                                    - will keep the beaches closed from any more swimmers.
                                    - will attack shark and lower the health meter ever few seconds when shark is at the same beach.
                                    - takes 2 shots to destroy them.
                                    - once destroyed the beaches are opened and the beach is filled with swimmers.
                              - Each boat destroyed will raise the shark's health meter.
                              - Once you eat enough swimmers a Bounty will be placed on you and time will expire on this Phase.

                    - Phase 2 - BOUNTY HUNTER
                              - Shoot the Boat/Shark Cage to attack Bounty Hunter and drain his meter.
                              - Green arrows light for 1X damage and combos can be shot for 2X damage.
                              - Shoot the Upper Playfield ramp to drain Bounty Hunter's entire health meter.
                              - Bounty Hunter will attach a barrel ever few seconds he is alive.
                              - Barrels have the following penalties:
                                    - 1 Barrel - Swimmers take twice as many chomps to eat in the "EAT SWIMMERS" phase.
                                    - 2 Barrels - Shark cannot Heal.
                                    - 3 Barrels - Shark Health meter is drained every few seconds.
                              - Leveling up your Shark will remove all attached Barrels.
                              - Defeating a Bounty Hunter will remove a single attached Barrel.
                              - Drain the Bounty Hunter's meter all the way to light a final shot at the Boat/Shark Cage.
                              - Higher levels require you to face more than one Bounty Hunter.

                    - Phase 3 - BONUS
                              - Collect a bonus point value for each Swimmer and Boat that was destroyed for this level.
                              - When your Growth meter is full your shark levels up now and resets until you reach Great White.
                              - Shark Levels:
                                    - Mako - 6 chomps per swimmer
                                    - Thresher - 5 chomps per swimmer
                                    - Hammerhead - 4 chomps per swimmer
                                    - Tiger - 3 chomps per swimmer
                                    - Great White - 2 chomps per swimmer

                    - Phase 4 - SHARK ALLEY
                              - Use Left or Right flipper buttons to chomp swimmers.
                              - Don't chomp fellow sharks.
                              - Don't wait too long or time will run out.

                    - Power Up - Shoot lit Drop Targets to light a roving Shark Tower Standup Target to begin a Power up for a limited period.
                               - Powered Up perks:
                                    - Shark becomes invincible.
                                    - Swimmers can be eaten with one chomp.
                                    - Bounty Hunters take 2X damage from all shots.

                    - Play through multiple levels of increasing difficulty until all lives are lost.
                    - Each eaten swimmer contributes to the Shark Bounty Value.

Update instructions - Games connected to Stern Insider Connected:
1 - Open the coin door and press the black/enter button to enter Test Mode.
2 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate to the Stern Insider Connected Setup menu.
3 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate down to the Software Update menu.
4 - If a software update is available, this page will give you the option to
    download and install it manually.  From this menu you can also select to install these
    updates automatically.

Update instructions - All Games:
1 - Download the zip file
2 - Unzip the file, this will create a folder that contains SPK file(s).
3 - Open the folder, copy the file(s) to the root level of a FAT32 formatted
    USB stick.  (Do not copy the folder.)
4 - Power game off
5 - Insert USB stick
6 - Turn on game
7 - After game boots up it will give the option for software update
8 - Volume buttons change options for full or quick update. Enter selects the
    option and starts the update.
9 - Once update is completed game will prompt user to power game off and
    remove USB stick.

    any lit shot for a 2X score award.  Any unused flips remaining at the end of each stage
    gets carried over to the next stage. Draining subtracts 5 flips and kicks the ball back
    into play.  Each awarded shot adds back 6 flips.  Once you make it to Stage 7 all of the
    shot arrows are lit.  Viggo's son Iosef is hiding under 1 of the lit arrow shots. Shoot the
    lit arrows to find Iosef and complete the mode.  Bonus points are awarded for any remaining
    flips.  If you run out of flips, "Special Assignment" Wizard Mode is over.  When over all
    of the balls are cycled back into the trough.  Game play advances to the next player or
    to the match/game over sequence.

 -  Added a new "Red Circle Reckoning" Wizard Mode rule.  Play all 5 of the following to

    1) Any Job Mode
    2) Any Adversary Battle
    3) Any Car Multiball
    4) Deconsecrated Multiball
    5) Excommunicado Multiball

    bumper hits advance towards "Adding Time" to the mode timer. Upon completion or mode timeout
    all of the balls are cycled back into the trough at which time 1 new ball is kicked into

    of balls in play.  Upon completion all of the balls are cycled back into the trough at which

Update instructions - Games connected to Stern Insider Connected:
1 - Open the coin door and press the black/enter button to enter Test Mode.
2 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate to the Stern Insider Connected Setup menu.
3 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate down to the Software Update menu.
4 - If a software update is available, this page will give you the option to
    download and install it manually.  From this menu you can also select to install these
    updates automatically.

Update instructions - All Games:
1 - Download the zip file
2 - Unzip the file, this will create a folder that contains SPK file(s).
3 - Open the folder, copy the file(s) to the root level of a FAT32 formatted
    USB stick.  (Do not copy the folder.)
4 - Power game off
5 - Insert USB stick
6 - Turn on game
7 - After game boots up it will give the option for software update
8 - Volume buttons change options for full or quick update. Enter selects the
    option and starts the update.
9 - Once update is completed game will prompt user to power game off and
    remove USB stick.

- Insider Connected - Home Team

      The Home Team features allows Insider Connected players to log in
      and play without scanning their QR code.
      When the game is registered to a home location and set to Free Play,
      Home Team can be enabled via Standard Adjust #51 or from Guided Setup.
      Up to 8 players can be added to the Home Team from the Stern Insider
      Connected Setup menu.

      The Home Team can be shared across all games registered at the game's
      location by enabling the Home Team Standard Adjustment on each game.
      Players need only be added once to the Home Team. Players can be
      later removed from the Home Team, and guests can be temporarily
      added to the Home Team.

      Find out more about Home Team at http://insider.sternpinball.com.

fields.machine_videomode: A video mode called “Balance the Dragons” is an 8-bit video game style mode which is qualified by achieving Super Slings and Super Spinners. The leftmost orbit will light blinking green to start. The mode is layered on too of any other mode that is running and lasts 20 seconds. The goal is to keep the “energy” of the blue and green dragons as close to middle of screen as possible to achieve maximum bonus. The idea of the mode is based on the Overwatch characters Genji and Hanzo, ninja brothers who often battle each other using their dragon energ.

Update instructions - Games connected to Stern Insider Connected:
1 - Open the coin door and press the black/enter button to enter Test Mode.
2 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate to the Stern Insider Connected Setup menu.
3 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate down to the Software Update menu.
4 - If a software update is available, this page will give you the option to
    download and install it manually.  From this menu you can also select to install these
    updates automatically.

Update instructions - All Games:
1 - Download the zip file
2 - Unzip the file, this will create a folder that contains SPK file(s).
3 - Open the folder, copy the file(s) to the root level of a FAT32 formatted
    USB stick.  (Do not copy the folder.)
4 - Power game off
5 - Insert USB stick
6 - Turn on game
7 - After game boots up it will give the option for software update
8 - Volume buttons change options for full or quick update. Enter selects the
    option and starts the update.
9 - Once update is completed game will prompt user to power game off and
    remove USB stick.

Update instructions - Games connected to Stern Insider Connected:
1 - Open the coin door and press the black/enter button to enter Test Mode.
2 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate to the Stern Insider Connected Setup menu.
3 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate down to the Software Update menu.
4 - If a software update is available, this page will give you the option to
    download and install it manually.  From this menu you can also select to install these
    updates automatically.

Update instructions - All Games:
1 - Download the zip file
2 - Unzip the file, this will create a folder that contains SPK file(s).
3 - Open the folder, copy the file(s) to the root level of a FAT32 formatted
    USB stick.  (Do not copy the folder.)
4 - Power game off
5 - Insert USB stick
6 - Turn on game
7 - After game boots up it will give the option for software update
8 - Volume buttons change options for full or quick update. Enter selects the
    option and starts the update.
9 - Once update is completed game will prompt user to power game off and
    remove USB stick.

New:
 - New DANGER ROOM rules
   - Before playing a mode or the FUTURE, training in the DANGER ROOM is now
     based on a progress bar.  Each DANGER ROOM feature (targets, spinner,
     ramp) advances the bar towards completing a level.  Each level
     completed will offer a possible TRAINING BOOST going into the next mode
     and FUTURE if the mode is completed.
     The levels and their TRAINING BOOSTS are:
     - Level 1 (GREEN) complete - DOUBLE scoring on the next mode.  All awards
       during the mode will be doubled.
     - Level 2 (YELLOW) complete - Next FUTURE is easier (1 shot fewer) to
       complete.
     - Level 3 (RED) complete - Next FUTURE has DOUBLE SENTINEL KILLS.

   - DANGER ROOM level will reset after a mode is played.

     so a DANGER ROOM BONUS value is now displayed.  DANGER ROOM elements
     build this bonus value and will be added to the MODE TOTAL if the mode
     is successfully completed.

     of each ball.

     has been collected.

Update instructions - Games connected to Stern Insider Connected:
1 - Open the coin door and press the black/enter button to enter Test Mode.
2 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate to the Stern Insider Connected Setup menu.
3 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate down to the Software Update menu.
4 - If a software update is available, this page will give you the option to
    download and install it manually.  From this menu you can also select to install these
    updates automatically.

Update instructions - All Games:
1 - Download the zip file
2 - Unzip the file, this will create a folder that contains SPK file(s).
3 - Open the folder, copy the file(s) to the root level of a FAT32 formatted
    USB stick.  (Do not copy the folder.)
4 - Power game off
5 - Insert USB stick
6 - Turn on game
7 - After game boots up it will give the option for software update
8 - Volume buttons change options for full or quick update. Enter selects the
    option and starts the update.
9 - Once update is completed game will prompt user to power game off and
    remove USB stick.

  V0.98 - July 1, 2026
============================
New:
 - SAVE THE CITY MULTIBALL is now treated as a wizard multiball. It can only
   be started during MAINPLAY, when no other mode or multiball is running.
   - Qualification now gets harder after each start:
     - 1st start: 3 completions at each of the 6 SAVE THE CITY shots
     - 2nd start: 4 completions at each shot
     - 3rd and later starts: 5 completions at each shot
   - SAVE THE CITY qualification progress is only earned while no multiball
     is active.

  V0.97 - January 29, 2026
     Escape The Future
============================
New:
 - New ESCAPE NIMROD mode replaces the FUTURE for 4 of the "challenging" 
   missions to rescue the X-Men and collect their perk.
   - Timer starts with 35 seconds (45 if played with Rogue's perk).
   - Ball saver of 10 seconds (15 if played with Wolverine's perk).
   - 3 red shots from a randomly chosen group will be lit.  Shoot
     to ESCAPE NIMROD.
   - The final 2 blue shots will light with a new 10 second timer.
     Shoot either to escape and rescue the X-men to collect their
     perk.
   - 4 SENTINELs are destroyed when the mode is completed. 
     Double if the DANGER ROOM was level 3 before playing 
     the MISSION.
   - If Rogue's perk is available, the DANGER ROOM spinner will
     freeze any timer for 7 seconds.
   - BISHOP is NOT available during ESCAPE NIMROD.
   - Draining or timing out will act the same as the FUTURE.
   - If played in competition mode, the shots will always be in the 
     same order.
   - Shot scoring is enhanced by the amount of time remaining on 
     the timer.

 - New SAVE SENATOR KELLY WIZARD mode, complete all 8 missions to 
   rescue the Senator from MYSTIQUE
   - Single ball wizard mode, played in 4 phases.
   - Ball saver of 40 seconds (50 if played with Wolverine's perk)
   - Phase 1, make 2 GREEN shots, then shoot CEREBRO.
   - Phase 2, make 3 YELLOW shots, then shoot CEREBRO.
   - Phase 3, make 4 ORANGE shots, then shoot CEREBRO.
   - Phase 4 is timed.  Starts with 60 seconds (70 if played with
     Magneto's perk).  Make 6 red shots, then shoot CEREBRO to
     capture MYSTIQUE.
   - Combos are the key to scoring.  All shots are scored with the 
     highest combo multiplier achieved during the mode.  
     Hitting a 3-way combo will maintain 3X scoring for the
     remainder of the mode!
   - Combos collected won't advance SENTINELS ATTACK or BEAST LAB.
   - BISHOP is NOT available during SAVE SENATOR KELLY
   - GAMBIT is NOT available during SAVE SENATOR KELLY

  V0.94 - October 2, 2025
     Danger Room Redux
============================
New:
 - New DANGER ROOM rules
   - Before playing a mode or the FUTURE, training in the DANGER ROOM is now
     based on a progress bar.  Each DANGER ROOM feature (targets, spinner,
     ramp) advances the bar towards completing a level.  Each level
     completed will offer a possible TRAINING BOOST going into the next mode
     and FUTURE if the mode is completed.
     The levels and their TRAINING BOOSTS are:
     - Level 1 (GREEN) complete - DOUBLE scoring on the next mode.  All awards
       during the mode will be doubled.
     - Level 2 (YELLOW) complete - Next FUTURE is easier (1 shot fewer) to
       complete.
     - Level 3 (RED) complete - Next FUTURE has DOUBLE SENTINEL KILLS.
     - Maxed - CYCLOPS will be collected and the CYCLOPS PERK awarded.
   - DANGER ROOM level will reset after a mode is played.
   - During a mode, the DANGER ROOM can no longer be used for training, 
     so a DANGER ROOM BONUS value is now displayed.  DANGER ROOM elements
     build this bonus value and will be added to the MODE TOTAL if the mode
     is successfully completed.
     10% of the DANGER ROOM BONUS value is applied to BONUS at the end 
     of each ball.

     This feature is also available in the FUTURE if the PROFESSOR X PERK
     has been collected.
   - During MULTIBALL the current DANGER ROOM level will add bonuses to each 
     award collected.
   - A DANGER ROOM DIFFICULTY adjustment controls how many features are needed
     in the DANGER ROOM to complete each level.

 - The KITTY PRYDE lane will add time while the SAVE THE CITY MULTIBALL 
   SUPER JACKPOT is active.

Update instructions - Games connected to Stern Insider Connected:
1 - Open the coin door and press the black/enter button to enter Test Mode.
2 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate to the Stern Insider Connected Setup menu.
3 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate down to the Software Update menu.
4 - If a software update is available, this page will give you the option to
    download and install it manually.  From this menu you can also select to install these
    updates automatically.

Update instructions - All Games:
1 - Download the zip file
2 - Unzip the file, this will create a folder that contains SPK file(s).
3 - Open the folder, copy the file(s) to the root level of a FAT32 formatted
    USB stick.  (Do not copy the folder.)
4 - Power game off
5 - Insert USB stick
6 - Turn on game
7 - After game boots up it will give the option for software update
8 - Volume buttons change options for full or quick update. Enter selects the
    option and starts the update.
9 - Once update is completed game will prompt user to power game off and
    remove USB stick.

Update instructions - Games connected to Stern Insider Connected:
1 - Open the coin door and press the black/enter button to enter Test Mode.
2 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate to the Stern Insider Connected Setup menu.
3 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate down to the Software Update menu.
4 - If a software update is available, this page will give you the option to
    download and install it manually.  From this menu you can also select to install these
    updates automatically.

Update instructions - All Games:
1 - Download the zip file
2 - Unzip the file, this will create a folder that contains SPK file(s).
3 - Open the folder, copy the file(s) to the root level of a FAT32 formatted
    USB stick.  (Do not copy the folder.)
4 - Power game off
5 - Insert USB stick
6 - Turn on game
7 - After game boots up it will give the option for software update
8 - Volume buttons change options for full or quick update. Enter selects the
    option and starts the update.
9 - Once update is completed game will prompt user to power game off and
    remove USB stick.

fields.machine_toys:
Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland blends cutting-edge innovation with high-end craftsmanship. The game features industry-first RGB interactive side rails, customizable via a dedicated mobile app, along with a fully RGB-lit shooter lane and dynamic lighting package. A mini upper playfield with Magna-Flip control introduces a unique electromagnet-based ball interaction system. The main playfield includes a motorized Jabberwock arm, hidden magnet, and a physical 3-ball lock, supporting multiple multiball modes up to 5 balls.
Art is a standout, with fully 3D-sculpted, hand-painted plastics by Lior under the art direction of Melvin Williams, complemented by a sculpted shooter handle and animated Cheshire Cat topper. A secondary IPS LCD display provides gameplay guidance.
Premium finishes include mirror-polished ball guides, powder-coated armor, non-reflective glass, and direct-printed mirror blades. Limited to 500 units, each game includes a numbered plaque and integrated shaker motor for an immersive experience.
fields.machine_comments:
- Production is limited to 500 machines, of which 300 are for the North American market.
-Game sold out in less than 10 hours!
-Pitch set between 6.8-7.0
-Knocker is active in attract mode (This game has some knockers)

RGB-lit fruit cellar lower playfield accessed through a motorized cellar door.
Pop-up Evil Scotty and Evil Ed bash toys.
Stepper-driven Evil Ash hand and a rotating good/evil Linda head in a vice.
Hidden flipper beneath the right slingshot area.
Cabin ball lock with a window ball lift and motorized porch swing release.
Moving lift ramp and rising Cheryl target bank.
Double-barrel Boomstick with sculpted shotgun-shell targets and dual shooter lanes.

fields.machine_comments:
Announced on November 22, 2024, Evil Dead was offered in a single Collector’s Edition with a planned run of 888 machines.
Bruce Campbell recorded custom Ash dialogue. Lara Sluyter voices Linda, and Scott Innes voices Professor Knowby.
This was the fourth game designed by “Spooky Luke” and Corwin “Bug” Emery, and the first Spooky title with a full art package by Christopher Franchi.
Ben Heck handled software, Matt Montgomery composed the score, and Back Alley Creations produced the playfield sculpts.
fields.machine_ornament: Direct-printed backglass, an LCD display and custom Ash speaker grilles with RGB lighting. An optional interactive Cheryl topper features a motorized, illuminated cellar-door scene with Cheryl rising from the opening and original movie callouts.
fields.machine_videomode: A retro action video mode was added in software v2025.10.03. It is accessed by finding hidden “lost tapes” during modes. Spooky describes it as a 1970s-style action game; subsequent updates adjusted scoring and added brief invincibility after respawning.

fields.machine_toys:
Six training modes allow you to practice a variety of techniques: circular blocks, vertical blocks, side blocks, balance, punches, and kicks.
Completing a training mode advances your belt ranking. Start with a white belt and work your way up through yellow, orange, green, purple, brown, and black belts.
Complete three training modes to earn a green belt and unlock a “Break Bricks” mini-wizard mode, which is a three-ball multiball where you can rack up points by bricking shots off of standup targets.
Complete all six training modes to earn a black belt and qualify for a tournament lasting up to four rounds.
If you play in at least one round of the tournament and haven’t yet drained your last ball, then you get to play a Victory Laps multiball. The better you do in the tournament, the more balls in the multiball.

Update instructions - Games connected to Stern Insider Connected:
1 - Open the coin door and press the black/enter button to enter Test Mode.
2 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate to the Stern Insider Connected Setup menu.
3 - Using the 4 buttons on the coin door, navigate down to the Software Update menu.
4 - If a software update is available, this page will give you the option to
    download and install it manually.  From this menu you can also select to install these
    updates automatically.

Update instructions - All Games:
1 - Download the zip file
2 - Unzip the file, this will create a folder that contains SPK file(s).
3 - Open the folder, copy the file(s) to the root level of a FAT32 formatted
    USB stick.  (Do not copy the folder.)
4 - Power game off
5 - Insert USB stick
6 - Turn on game
7 - After game boots up it will give the option for software update
8 - Volume buttons change options for full or quick update. Enter selects the
    option and starts the update.
9 - Once update is completed game will prompt user to power game off and
    remove USB stick.

   - Any time a combo is running (at least 2 shots), the Overlord will light to collect the combo.
   - Collecting the combo at the Overlord will add it to your Best of You combo board, 
     scores 3x the current combo value (or 5x if you hit the back target inside the Overlord), 
     and ends the combo.
   - Each combo collected will increases the COMBO COUNT on the combotron display, 
     and if it is a top 3 combo it will go into the Best of You chart. 
   - After 6 combos collected this way, Combotron Multiball is lit.
   - The number of combos to qualify the next Combotron Multiball is increased by 3 
     each time Combotron Multiball is finished.

COMBOTRON MULTIBALL
 - During Combotron multiball, lit combos score based on their color and keep the Combotron music playing;
   if you take too long to continue the combo, the music will stop and combo color levels will be reset.
 - Hit any red combo to light Overlord for Combotron Jackpot.
 - Hitting unique red combos will increase the Combotron Jackpot multiplier, to a maximum of 5x.
 - Combotron jackpot value is 20% of all combo shot values made, including any Foobot shot multipliers
   but not including Playfield X or Raygun X.
 - add combotron multiball achievements
 - Add high score entries for Combotron Multiball and Combotron Combo Collect Champion   

TOY TIME MULTIBALL
 - Light TOY TIME MULTIBALL
   - With topper installed:
       - Collect all 6 Band Member Combos to light Toy Time Multiball.
          - With the topper installed, collecting a band member combo will light the band member on 
            the front of the topper. By default, these lights carry across players and games 
            unless competition is installed. This behavior can be altered by the adjustment:

            TOPPER FEATURE PERSIST BEHAVIOR - 
                This adjustment controls whether or not band members to qualify Toy Time multiball 
                carry across players and games, or always start fresh each player, each game.
                * PERSIST UNLESS COMPETITION (default) - band member topper light progress is shared 
                  amongst players and carry across games unless Competition Mode is installed.
                * ALWAYS PERSIST - band member topper lights always carry over across players and games.
                * NEVER PERSIST  - band member topper lights are not shared between players and do not carry 
                                   over between games.
   - With no topper installed:
       - Collect all 6 Band Member Combos and the 6 cities to light Toy Time Multiball.

 - TOY TIME MULTIBALL Rules
   - Make a band member shot, then collect enough switches to light band member jackpot,
     or continue hitting shots to build the jackpot value.
   - Hit both Overlord targets to light Overlord lock for a timed lock where all switches count 
     double towards lighting jackpot and shots boost the jackpot twice as much.
   - Each band member jackpot adds a ball and lets you repeat the process with another band member
   - Once all band member jackpots have been collected, collect the Foobot Jackpot at the Overlord 
     for big points + instantly award a Foobot part (unless you have all parts, then it will instantly upgrade a part).

   - If a Van Mode is running while Modulator Frenzy is running, shots to the paddle will instantly either add time,
     boost scoring, or spot a shot in the current van mode.
