  - Reworked the shot multipliers and the shot multiplier HSTD total
    sequence logic such that there can be continuation (i.e. left loop
    switch -&amp;amp;amp;gt; left loop, center lane rollover -&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; center lane (tower)
    standup target, right loop switch -&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; right loop), instead of the
    sequence being killed after the first group of awards.
  - Fixed multi-kill total initialization problem that was causing the
    total to display as garbage if no shots were made that ball.
  - Woodbury skill shot was allowed during blood bath multiball and
    crossbow multiball.  This has been corrected.
  - Woodbury skill shot "active" has been added to the criteria for
    "timers off".  Added "timers off" logic to the star rollovers, the
    second shooter lane switch, and the top lane rollovers.
  - Cleaned up skill shot text (now uses game-specific fonts).  Cleaned
    up blinking -- starts with the title/score on the screen, ends with
    the title/score on the screen.
  - Changed multiball stacking.  Prison and well and crossbow are no
    longer allowed together.  Blood bath is the only one allowed to stack
    with something else.
  - Added a HSTD for the most walkers killed.
  - Cleaned up the pop bumper jackpot increased award display effect.
    Fixed vertical spacing.  Jackpot value now updates dynamically each
    render, instead of the value being passed as an argument and rendered
    statically.
  - Well walker multiball -- Added more information to the background
    display effect.  Switch hits were not being added to the well letter
    value.  This has been corrected.  Fixed the adjustment for well
    walker so it is not so brutal to start it a second time.  Fixed
    well scoring (the values were adding an extra increment that they
    should not have been).  Fixed post-super jackpot scoring.
  - Blood bath switch hit score goes up by 1K each time the drop target
    bank is completed.  Blood bath lamp turned on solid when blood bath is
    active.  Blood bath jackpot and super jackpot were not adding their
    scored points to the total.  This has been corrected.  Blood bath
    jackpot was not being added to the super jackpot when scored.  This
    has been corrected.  Add-as-balls awarded for completing the bank and
    collecting all of the supplies (controlled by adjustments).
  - Added instructions and transitions to multi-kill mode start display
    effects.
  - Added sounds for game start start button and player added.  Removed
    weak sounds from the skill shot background.
  - Added tilt warning and tilt sounds.
  - Added an adjustment to control how the multi-kill shot moves around
    after it has been collected (RANDOM, LEFT-TO-RIGHT, RIGHT-TO-LEFT).
    Competition mode installs the LEFT TO RIGHT setting.
  - Changed up multi-kill modes.  Scoring is based on the achievements
    earned to start the modes.  Only one shot is ever lit, no matter how
    many are started.  Each start indicates which shot should be lit, so
    there will be a connection to the achievement and the shot lit.
    (For example, completing bicycle girl lights the left ramp multi-kill
    shot).
  - Changed multi-kill scoring to be based on the points scored during the
    mode that started the multi-kill.
  - Fixed issues with the background music and display being updated/run at
    the proper time.
  - Fixed up CDC scoring.  When the mode starts, the left ramp is the only
    shot that is available and it may be looped any number of times to build
    up the value and light additional shots on the playfield (red arrows).
    Shooting one of the red arrow shots enables the left ramp for mode
    completion (2 shots).  Completing the mode (1 left ramp shot, followed by
    1 to 4 red arrow shots, followed by 2 left ramp shots) starts one of the
    multi-kill modes (adjustable).
  - Cleaned up attract mode display effects for blood bath HSTD and bicycle
    girl HSTD.
  - Added art for for the combo champion display in the attract mode.
  - Match speech was running past the end of the display effect.  This has
    been corrected.
  - Fixed up shot multiplier X champion to record the scores for each
    individual feature that contributes to the total.  Added logic to record
    the X champion for HSTD.
  - Fixed modules that weren't multiplying their scores by the shot
    multiplier.  This included combos and bicycle girl.
  - Added flipper button speech to the attract mode.
  - Reworked bonus so it counts up instead of counting down.  Reworked the
    bonus effect to show the number of walker kills while the zombie pile
    animation runs.  Added sounds and a lamp effect.  Added left/right side
    pile based on the last walker killed.  The lamp effect shows the lights
    in the order in which the walkers were killed.  Fixed bonus scoring so
    it only scores for walkers killed.  This means it is possible to receive
    no bonus if no walkers are killed.  If that is the case, then the bonus
    effect will not run.
  - Food increases a shot multiplier for the well.  The multiplier is
    awarded for any hit to the well (letter, well, well multiball), then
    reset.
  - First Aid increases a shot multiplier for the prison.  The multiplier
    is awarded for any hit to the prison (letter, prison, prison multiball,
    siege), then reset.
  - Removed animals from the crossbow mode, per AMC request.
  - Art changed for skill shot walker.
  - Removed walker kills that AMC does not like (lawnmower, trident,
    chainsaw attached to stump).
  - Added art/sounds for BARN mode.  Changed scoring.  Barn walker types
    (6) now added to a history list.  When a walker is started the list is
    checked and another walker is chosen if the walker has been started
    recently.  Added sorted rendering based on priority so the barn walkers
    show up on the correct layers.  Larger walkers move faster and are
    rendered last.  Smaller walkers move slower and are rendered first.
    Changed the barn walker kill selection algorithm to kill the walker
    that is the farthest away from the barn.
  - Off-screen prison walkers were making sounds when it appeared that all
    of the on-screen walkers had been killed.  This has been corrected.

V1.19 - November 25, 2014
=========================

  - Fixed an issue in which LED lights were being turned off under certain
    conditions when they should stay on.
  - Added LED GI functionality for LE.
  - Added lamp effects for the fish tank.
  - Added rules/art/sounds for the right drop target and the spinners:
      - Right drop target lights both spinners and the Woodbury skill shot.
      - Both spinners are lit for additional points until the Woodbury shot
        is made.
  - Fixed wire colors for TOPPER coil (flasher) drives (BRN now ORG)
  - Skill Shot:
      - removed tower shot
      - changed scoring
      - changed animation to be a walker in a hallway
        -- 0 rollover + top lane = shoot with pistol
        -- 1 rollover + top lane = shoot with shotgun
        -- 2 rollovers + top lane = shoot with bigger shotgun
  - Woodbury: updated art and music.
  - Multikill - added animations, VO, and sound FX.
  - Reworked the CDC rule.  The left ramp can be made repeatedly to build
    a score and add shots (arrows).  Once at least one arrow shot has been
    made, the left ramp can be shot twice to finish the mode and start a
    multi-kill feature.
  - Added new art for CDC (passing through the door - the door opens down,
    not up).  Lowered the left ramp shot increment for CDC mode.  This was
    scoring too much.
  - Reworked clear the prison yard and prison multiball scoring.  Completing
    the drop targets when "FIRST AID" is lit will permanently increase the
    value of the prison yard walkers for the remainder of the game.  During
    the multiball, the value of the prison yard walkers increases each time
    a prison yard walker is killed while the multiball is running.  Added
    all player scores to the prison yard walker background.  Added animated
    walkers to the prison yard background display effect.  Every once in a
    while, one of the walkers will start moving around and make some noises.
    Killing a walker will play an animation of the walker getting shot in the
    head.  Dead walkers remain on the ground so the player can look at the
    display and see how many walkers there are left to kill.  Fixed walker
    rendering (depth) based on distance to player.  Prison multiball super
    jackpot is no longer laughable.
  - Siege: Added rules, animations, sound FX, music.
    Light Siege by killing 12 yard walker during Prison MB.
  - Reworked the TUNNEL rule.  All shots are lit, and each shot collected
    doubles the value of the next shot.  Shooting the TUNNEL shot completes
    the mode and starts a multi-kill feature.  Added dots and sounds.  The
    award sound is now louder, and ducks the music.  Added scrolling
    messages.
  - Added barn walkers.
  - Added walker kill animations
  - Made some sounds louder (bicycle girl, prison).
  - Added art for combos.
  - Added some high scores.
  - Added stacking to crossbow lit.  Lit crossbows can be stacked (via
    adj.) by completing the drop targets multiple times when "Weapons" is
    lit before shooting the crossbow ramp.
  - Added add-a-ball to blood bath multiball.  This is earned by completing
    the drop targets.
  - Added art to pop bumper jackpot display effect.
  - Arena: Added rules/art/sounds.
  - Added left target bank completion parameters for blood bath lit and
    modes lit.
  - Implemented drop target settings for lighting modes.
  - Added settings for crossbow kills for crossbow multiball.
  - Added new crossbow art (raccoon and half walker).
  - Added player scores to well attack background.
  - Well walker (non-multiball) was not allowing the woodbury skill shot
    to be available.  This is now allowed.
  - Fixed a problem with the right drop target and WOODBURY that was causing
    the drop target to stay down when it should have been up.
  - Added a display effect for prison multiball super jackpot.

V1.11 - October 28, 2014
========================

  - Bicycle girl ramp diverter waits 1.5 seconds to close after a recent
    hit to the head when the ramp is up.
  - Changed prison arrow color to teal/blue (similar color to Prison insert
    outline color).
  - Changed rollover default color to orange.
  - RGB arrow colors for bicycle girl, blood bath, crossbow, prison.  The
    default arrow color is RED, which is used by combo shots.
  - Completing the right drop target lights Woodbury, along with the spinners
    for extra points.  Shooting the Woodbury lane collects the spinner points
    (this can be multiplied).
  - Changed behavior of RGB lights during Single Lamp Test and All Lamp Test.
    The Enter/Start button will cycle white/red/green/blue.
  - Lamp table so the lamp test menu shows the board number that the lamp is
    associated with.
  - Fixed up attract mode for LE version.
  - Added extra ball lit and woodbury lit to right drop target up/down criteria.

  - Fixed topper wire colors (ORG should have been BRN).
  - Fixed shooter lane awards (extra ball, etc.) when they were not
    supposed to be given.
  - Added new sounds.
  - Fixed a problem with the BARN mode art that was causing a keyframe
    error.
  - Extended the time for a crossbow shot (ball fired from the crossbow),
    as valid shots to the longer shots (left ramp, etc.) were timing out.
  - Added sounds for bicycle girl hit when the display effect cannot run.
  - Removed "crickets" sound from woodbury-is-lit event.  This event occurs
    when the fish tank is completed, so there is already an award sound
    happening at this time.
  - Added crossbow kill animations.
  - Added crossbow shots, lit by completing the drop targets when "Weapons"
    is lit.
  - Removed check to see if a supply had already been awarded before awarding
    it again.  This allows the crossbow to be lit more often.
  - Zombie kills lamp effect now shows lane-changeable lamps.
  - Added some basic flasher effects for the topper heads in the attract mode.
  - Added bicycle girl lamp to background lamp effect.  Lowered the priority
    of the multi-kill award display effects so the effects won't block the
    multiball award effects (prison, well).
  - Added prison multiball award dots.
  - Added prison multiball start dots.

    --- Official Bride of Pinbot 2.0 Version Change Log by Dutch Pinball ---

Beta Version 1.17 - August 5th 2016

  Rules:
  - If a wheel mode is interupted by a multiball, it will now continue after the
    multiball has ended.
  - During wheel modes, shooting the scoop (if not lit for a shot) now adds 5
    seconds to the remaining mode time. A setting to tweak this time was added:
    "Adjustments Menu -&amp;amp;gt; Rules -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Wheel -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Scoop time added".
  - The default amount of jackpots needed to complete Multiball 1 has been
    reduced to 3. This is still a setting that can be set anywhere from 1 to 10.
  - The default amount of PIN*BOT letters that are pre-lit has been raised to 3.
    This means videomode is easier to lite the first time. This is still a
    setting that can be set anywhere from 0 to 6.

  Improvements:
  - Live DMD is now also updating during PinMAME emulation.
  - Holding the start button can now remove the last player from a game if he is
    still at 00 points (useful for any accidental player additions).
  - Holding the start button is now visualized by a popup that tells you what
    action is being executed (removing player, stopping game, to game launcher).
  - To enter profile selection during skillshot you now have to hold the right
    flipper button, to minimize accidental entering of the profile menu. This is
    now also visualized by a popup.
  - After selecting a profile you can now enter a "Profile Info" menu with the
    right flipper button. This lets you view your highscores and trophies, and
    let's you update your profile or logout.
  - Trophies used to be either 1, 2 or 3 stars. This has now changed to bronze,
    silver, gold and platinum. The platinum trophy is awarded when the player
    has collected all other trophies.
  - Updated animations for "Extra Ball" mode so the 4 screen panels now better
    match the orange extra ball inserts.

  Service menu:
  - Added 3 settings to "Adjustment Menu -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Start Button". To enable or disable
    the functions for holding the start button. Useful for operators or tour-
    naments where you want to disable restarts or access to PinMAME software.
  - Added "Software Menu -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Current version -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Factory Reset" menu item, which
    performs a factory reset for the current version, resetting all settings,
    audits, highscores &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; profiles.
  - If you experienced a delay when entering the service menu this was likely
    caused by the player profiles menu being repopulated every time. To fix this
    delay we now only load the player profiles when this item is selected.

  Bugfixes:
  - PinMAME emulation did not show periods (commas were fine).
  - Game/skillshot "Planet PIN*BOT" intro would keep showing for subsequent
    skillshots if it wasn't watched till the end previously. Also it was missing
    the voicecall since version 1.14. Now added 2 alternative "welcome back"
    voicecalls for subsequent games.
  - Trophy title only showing half or not at all during bonus countdown.

Version 1.16 - January 14th 2016
  - Added setting "Adjustment Menu -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Pricing -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Units per credit".
    This provides fractional credits functionality. The existing settings for
    the 4 coin slots now define how many "credit units" each coin adds.
  - Bugfix: Live functionality from v1.15 caused game to freeze in some cases.
  - Bugfix: if a flipper is held this now prevents a ballsearch from starting.

Version 1.15 - December 24th 2015
  - Multiple CPU cores are now utilized which improves performance overall, most
    notably Videomode and the PinMAME alphanumeric display emulation.
  - Added support for future "Delta" updates, meaning future updates can be much
    smaller in size if updated from at least version 1.15.
  - Changed  "Adjustment Menu -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Live -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; DMD update interval" setting, it's now
    called "Live DMD framerate" and supports up to 16 frames per second.
  - Tournament Mode removes the credits scroll and some logos from attract mode
    to maximize screen time for the Game Over / last scores screen.
  - Colorized highscore "Skip / Save score" screen.
  - Bugfix: Slingshots and jets coil strength settings didn't update right away.
  - Bugfix: Slingshots and Jets wouldn't disable when the game was tilted.
  - Removed various legacy display settings to keep in line with our latest
    codebase. Specifically removed classic dmd support, color display mono-
    chromatic color settings and background color settings.

Version 1.14 - November 6th 2015 - Alivia benefit event exclusive
  - Added basic coin support. Settings for Freeplay and the coin slots added
    under "Adjustments Menu -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Rules -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Pricing".
  - Added Tournament Mode setting under "Adjustments Menu -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Rules". Tournament
    Mode eliminates the randomization in the "Slot Machine" mode.
  - Added three settings under "Adjustments Menu -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Rules -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Extra Balls" for
    the maximum extra balls (total &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; per ball), and the alternative award score.
  - During "Mission Control" the heartbeat ramp no longer lites locks for the
    Multiball 2 since the locks can't be made during this mode and the lit locks
    time out.
  - Updated "Planet Python" callout to "Planet Pythonia".
  - Skillshot bonus category is now more in balance with other bonus categories.
    Now a normal skillshot is 25k in bonus and a super skillshot 125k. It used
    to be the entire skillshot value, which made skillshots too valuable.
  - Super Skillshot difficulty increases after each collected Super Skillshot.
    The walking light will increase in speed and vary directions later on.

Version 1.13 - August 7th 2015
  - Changed "Planet Python" to "Planet Pythonia", as we have now learned this is
    actually where Python Anghelo said he would go back to when he passed away.
  - After 100% completing a Small Wheel mode, a Big Wheel mode is lit. After
    playing the Big Wheel Mode, a Small Wheel Mode will be lit again, etc.
  - Tweaked some of the trophies' stars (indication of difficulty).
  - Tweaked and added basic point scoring and bonus "Story Progress" points
    for shots towards Multiball 2 and Metamorphosis.
  - Added trophy "Completed Small Wheel", awarded when all the Small Wheel modes
    are started within one game.
  - Added trophy "Completed Big Wheel", awarded when all the Big Wheel modes are
    started within one game.

Version 1.122 - August 5th 2015
  - This is a Pre-Beta version that skips Multiball 1 and only lites Big Wheel
    modes for testing purposes.
  - Added callouts and sounds for the Big Wheel mode titles and awards.
  - Metamorphosis heartbeat startup now indicates that the heart rate level is
    about to drop down again by blinking the blocks and using the helmet lights.
  - Added setting "Heart rate drop time" to "Rules -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Multiball" Which
    determines how much time you have before the heart rate drops down a level.
  - Added a lightshow to the Metamorphosis start.
  - During "Planet Python" the ramps are no longer available for progressing
    towards multiball. This stack was buggy and confusingly different for the
    various multiballs. Also fixes a jackpot value bug (value ending in ,999).
  - Added ball saver to "Big Wheel Billion", the duration of the ball saver is a
    setting found under "Adjustment Menu -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Rules -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Wheel -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Big Wheel".
  - Finishing "Big Wheel Billion" no longer raises the jackpot value or awards
    Double Scoring, to be consistent with the other Big Wheel modes. Also the
    intro for this mode can't be skipped anymore to build the tension.
  - Bugfix: during Metamorphosis the head would move to the wrong face if it was
    at the face with the eye holes while starting Metamorphosis.
  - Bugfix: During "Shooting Range" the mini playfield gate no longer opens when
    the shuttle ramp shot is lit or just before that.
  - Bugfix: If the scoop was shot at the end of the "Slot Machine" mode, the
    ball would not eject.
  - Bugfix: "Live" related memory leak resulting in low framerates and crashes.

Version 1.121 - July 29th 2015
  - This is a Pre-Beta version that skips Multiball 1 and only lites Big Wheel
    modes for testing purposes.
  - Added Heartbeat phase, Metamorphosis &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; Unlimited balls multiball that is
    reached after Multiball 2 is completed.
  - Added 6 Big Wheel modes. The Billion mode is always the last Big Wheel mode.
  - Added trophy "Welcome to the Billionaires Club", awarded when you complete
    the "Big Wheel Billion" mode.
  - Added trophy "R.I.P. Python Anghelo", awarded when you spell PLANET PYTHON
    3 times in the "Planet Python" mode.
  - Added trophy "Combo King", awarded when you complete 2 combos in the "Cosmic
    Combos" mode.
  - Added trophy "Single-handedly", awarded when you collect 3 awards in the
    "Slot Machine" mode.
  - Added trophy "Sharpshooter", awarded when you collect all 6 different shots
    in the "Shooting Range" mode.
  - Added trophy "To the limit", awarded when you collect a 10M award in the
    "Unlimited Millions" mode.
  - Added trophy "She's alive!", awarded when you reach the Metamorphosis.
  - Added settings for each Big Wheel length to "Rules -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Wheel -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Big Wheel".
  - If the audio jack is not plugged in properly when booting, the game now
    informs you about it and restarts when the jack is plugged in.
  - If the P-ROC is not connected or powered correctly, the game now informs
    you about it and restarts when the situation is resolved.
  - Improved loading time by about 50% and changed the helmet lights during it.
  - Service menu opens much quicker the first time you open it.
  - Moved "Power Charge time" setting to subfolder "Rules -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Multiball".
  - Moved "Values doubled time" setting to subfolder "Rules -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Wheel".
  - Bugfix: Hitting the 5K targets during Multiball 2 made the display go black
    for most of the remaining Multiball.

Version 1.12 - May 22th 2015
  - Bugfix: Retry P-ROC initialization over a period of 10 seconds if it fails.
  - Bugfix: Failed Internet Update list retrieval would restart the game.

Version 1.11 - May 20th 2015
  - Public release of the 1.10x beta updates' changes.
  - Added "Software Menu -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Internet update" item to service menu, where you
    can, if connected to the internet, download future updates.
  - Added settings under "Adjustment Menu -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Sound" for music, SFX and voice
    volume. Normal volume control is called master volume here.
  - Colorized USB update screens.
  - Bugfix: Disk space error in USB update would not show up properly.

Beta Version 1.103 - April 24th 2015
  - Sound volume can now be controlled to a finer degree.
  - Game launcher can now be controlled by coin door buttons too in addition to
    the flippers and start button.
  - Added scoring to in/outlanes (25k)
  - Slingshots now award 10 points to increase randomization of scores.
  - Jets now award 10010 instead of 10k to increase randomization of scores.
  - Added setting "Adjustment Menu -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Live -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; DMD update interval", which
    specifies the interval at which DMD screenshots are send to the Live server.
    Defaults to "1 second"; increase or set to "off" if bandwidth is tight.
  - Added settings under "Adjustment Menu -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Coil Strengths" for all pulsing
    coils. Trick: Holding Enter down for a second on a value does a test pulse.
    Also tweaked some of the default pulse lengths down.
  - Added 3 options under "Software Menu -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Current Version":
    - "Exit current game" exits the running game - equivalent to holding the
      start button while in game.
    - "Exit to launcher" exits to the game launcher - equivalent to holding the
      start button while in attract mode.
    - Restarts the current software version if needed for some reason.
  - Removed setting "Adjustment Menu -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Live -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Live host" from service menu.
  - Removed setting "Adjustment Menu -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Sound volume" from service menu.
  - Removed "Adjustment Menu -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Game" and moved items to elsewhere in the menu.
  - Flipper Switch Mod support: Flippers disabled during bonus count down and
    implemented paging through attract mode screens.

Beta Version 1.102 - April 17th 2015
  - Added Multiball 2 "Activating the Bride", which can be build towards after
    finishing Multiball 1 (arriving at Planet PIN*BOT).
  - Added trophy "Batteries not included", awarded when you start Multiball 2
    (by unloading the 3 power cells from the space shuttle).
  - Added trophy "Now I see you", awarded when you complete Multiball 2.
  - Tweaked videomode levels based on feedback from MGC.
  - Videomode now defaults to 0 extra lives, but up to 3 extra lives can be
    earned by shooting the mini playfield while the videomode is already lit.
  - Every 5 seconds the current DMD image is send to the Live server (if Live
    is enabled).

Alpha Version 1.101 - April 10th 2015 - MGC Exclusive
  - Added Videomode, which can be lit by spelling PIN*BOT at the mini playfield
    (when nothing is lit at the shuttle ramp), and then started at the scoop -
    indicated by a faster blinking "Spin small wheel" insert.
  - Gate to mini playfield now opens up during wheel modes too (except EB mode),
    and skillshots are awarded too.
  - Added setting "Adjustment Menu -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Peripherals -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Flipper Switch Mod", which
    adds support for the "BoP2.0 Flipper Switch Mod" by disabling the flipper
    coils while in player profile menus and Videomode.
  - Added setting "Adjustment Menu -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Rules -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Videomode -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Videomode enabled",
    (enabled by default), if disabled the mini playfield functionality is the
    same as in previous versions.
  - Added setting "Adjustment Menu -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Rules -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Videomode -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; PIN*BOT letters
    pre-lit", which can make lighting videomode easier (but 0 by default).
  - Added trophy "Lights out, away we go!", awarded when you start Videomode.
  - Added trophy "Seasoned Racer", awarded when you finish Videomode level 6.
  - First shot animation of the G-Force Challenge mode now loops properly.
  - 75K Super skillshot animation text effect fixed.
  - Bugfix: During MB1 the shuttle and travel dots did not match up if setting
    "Adjustment Menu -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Rules -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Multiball 1 -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Jackpots required" was changed
    from the default value. The range for this setting is now limited to 1 to 6.

Version 1.10 - March 20th 2015
  - Public release of the 1.09x beta updates' changes.
  - Colorized jackpot value font.
  - Improved the White Water-esque multiplier (heartbeat ramp) period at the
    start of multiball; it no longer listens to the left inlane switch but
    instead stops 3.5 seconds after the 3rd ball is released.
  - Improved USB stick reading; this now (for future updates) only happens on
    request, so the stick can be inserted while the game is already running.
  - Bugfix: flippers would sometimes get disabled by the watchdog while in
    service menu. Now the flippers will get enabled again if this happens.
  - Bugfix: 5k targets would only award 5k when blinking, now they always do.
  - Bugfix: blinking 5k targets would only show their accompanying visual
    towards bonus multiplier during general gameplay, now they always do.
  - Bugfix: service menu would often break when deleting player profiles
    or when installing / delete software versions.

Beta Version 1.092 - February 20th 2015
  - PinMAME: added L-6 ROM.
  - Added setting "Software Menu -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; PinMAME ROM". Which enables switching
    between ROMs L-6, L-7, or other ROMs added to the pinmame\roms\ folder (at
    your own risk).
  - 5k Target inserts now blink during the bonus countdown multiplier screen.
  - Bugfix: Bonus multiplier sound during gameplay and bonus countdown would not
    play correctly for all multiplier levels.
  - Bugfix: Ball tracking bug resulting in the turn being ended, most frequently
    experienced during super jackpot phase (introduced in 1.091).
  - Bugfix: no skillshot would be awarded if ball came from right mini playfield
    exit (introduced in 1.091).

Beta Version 1.091 - January 23th 2015
  - Improved ball search, it is no longer canceled by flippers, listens to more
    switches and pulses more solenoids including the lock post (after the first
    ball search).
  - Improved trough and lock trough ball tracking. Should now be able to
    correctly handle airballs to the head and the lock post releasing multiple
    balls.
  - Slightly improved helmet lights strobing when using LEDs, but incandescents
    still yield much better results.
  - Heartbeat ramp hits no longer require the entrance switch to work. Instead
    the miniplayfield left exit is checked.
  - Status report during multiball now only triggers with 2 flippers up.
  - Colorized status report.
  - Fixed some color issues with skillshot animations.
  - Bugfix: Ball saver showing animation when draining trough outlanes, but then
    ball would be ended anyway (when 2 balls were in the lock tray).
  - Bugfix: Changed the way skillshots are awarded from the miniplayfield. This
    would sometimes cause a crash when the twisty ramp wasn't working right or
    if the mini playfield exit gates were swapped.
  - Bugfix: bonus countdown trophy screens text formatting fixed.
  - Bugfix: don't start game or add player when pressing start in service menu.
  - Bugfix: flasher locked on (experienced mostly during wheel modes) fixed.
  - PinMAME flipper switch detection (lane change &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; initials entry) fixed.
  - PinMAME flippers are now disabled during attract mode.
  - PinMAME can now be closed by holding the start button for 0.75 seconds,
    similar to closing BoP2.0 and returning to the launch menu.
  - PinMAME helmet lights now show a lightshow.
  - PinMAME head motor is now controlled via the aux port.
    These PinMAME improvements are courtesy of Mark Sunnucks (a.k.a. Snux)!
    Thank you Mark for working with us to improve the emulated BoP experience.

Version 1.09 - November 27th 2014
  - Nicer alphanumeric display simulation for PinMAME.
  - PinMAME settings are now carried over when updating.
  - Added "Player Profiles" menu to the service menu. Basic functionality
    right now allows to edit and delete existing profiles.
  - Colorized launch menu.
  - Colorized PIN*BOT spelling.
  - Colorized Values Doubled status bar.
  - Added setting "Adjustment Menu -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Rules -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Wheel -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Small Wheel -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
    EB mode -&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; Lanes can unlite". By default the extra ball lanes during the
    EB mode now can't unlite to avoid confusion. Also double switch hits
    (ball bouncing when falling out of the left ramp) won't register double
    hits anymore - except if you skillfully do a lane change in between (for
    Shatzing the inlane).
  - Improved performance of service menu.
  - Bugfix: Bonus total is now correctly displayed (what was previously
    displayed was the unmultiplied total, even though the awarded score was
    multiplied).
  - Bugfix: a selected profile's initials would get overwritten if a logged in
    user switched to a "new" profile.
  - Bugfix: skipping the "Player X Shoot Again" animation would freeze the game.
  - Bugfix: pressing the start button during some profile related yes/no prompts
    would crash the game.

Version 1.08 - November 13th 2014
  - Initial release.

Whiplash ball accelerator: Ball-catching mechanism which whips the ball around the playfield.

fields.machine_comments:
The seven stand up targets and their inserts do not say IRON MAN on them, because the license states that the words IRON and MAN can never be separated.
IMVE was the first machine to be fitted with an upgraded trough opto connector that had previously caused Stern SAM games to be plagued with the inexplicable "ball end mid-ball" issue.

V 01.86.0 - 28-April-2020
=========================

- Removed ADD-A-BALL from the SHILED award for DO OR DIE MULTIBALL, as
  the multiball continuously serves all of the balls from the trough for
  the duration of the multiball, so ADD-A-BALL doesn't make sense here.
- Added settings for SHIELD EXTRA BALL and SHIELD SPECIAL; these allow
  the user to enable (the default) or disbale these features as desired.
- Fixed a problem with the implementation of the IRONMAN TARGET
  DIFFICULTY adjustment.  The MEDIUM setting was implemented correctly,
  but the EXTRA EASY setting was implemented as EXTRA HARD and the
  EASY setting was implemented as HARD.  This has been changed to a
  new setting, 1ST HARD IRONMAN TARGET SET; the range is 1-10 and the
  default is 4, which corresponds to starting the second IRONMAN FAST
  SCORING mode, which is the same as the previous implementation for
  the MEDIUM setting (most games).
- Reworked the 1ST HARD BOGEY RAMP (SET) adjustment to be more logically
  readable; the behavior is the same, but instead of a default value of
  '1' (which implies the first ramp set is hard, which it isn't and never
  was), the default is now '2' (second set).  The range has been changed
  from 0-10 to 1-10, as setting the adjustment to 0 (the 0th set) also
  doesn't make much sense.
- Implemented the MUSIC ATTENUATION and SPEECH ATTENUATION adjustments;
  these were not implemented.
- Fixed a display bug in the WHIPLASH MULTIBALL background display effect
  that was causing the number of hits left to light the super jackpot to
  be displayed incorrectly.
- Updated default initials for some High Score To Date entries.

V 01.85.0 - 11-March-2020
=========================

- Added a new skill shot rule:
    - Activate by holding in the left flipper button and plunging the ball
      to the top lanes.
    - The left orbit up-post will remain DOWN and the normal skill shot will
      be disabled.
    - Either lane will award 1M + 250K for each additional skill shot made
      (old or new).
- Whiplash multiball autofire time increased from 5 seconds to 10 seconds.
- Added additional information to the background display effect for WHIPLASH
  multiball.
- Whiplash multiball jackpots increased from 250K to 350K + an additional
  12.5K per shot made, up to a maximum of 500K.
- Added new effects for WHIPLASH multiball 1/2-way jackpot (the first award
  that is collected at the WHIPLASH targets).  Formerly, this required two
  shots for 500K and 1M.  Now, this requires one shot for 2.5M.
- Added new effects for WHIPLASH multiball super jackpot (the second award
  that is collected at the WHIPLASH targets).  The score has been increased
  from 3M to 5M.
- Fixed an issue with the speech for HIGH SCORE TO DATE that would cause
  some of the phrases to be repeated back to back.
- Added speech for the flipper buttons in ATTRACT MODE.
- Added speech at game start.
- Added a setting that allows the IRON MAN mode (FAST SCORING, 2X SCORING,
  HURRY-UP) to be started when READY during MULTIBALL.  The current default
  is OFF (i.e. to not allow the mode to start; this is the same behavior as
  before).
- Fixed an issue where the background lamp effect for the IRON MAN mode
  start ready (the pulsing lights on the IRON MAN targets) would run when
  the mode had been qualified but could not be started (during multiball).
- USA default game pricing changed to USA 11 (1/$1 3/$2).
- Added an EXTRA BALL for completing the IRON MAN standup targets.  The
  current default (adjustable) is 2 completions.
- Fixed errors in text and limit values of adjustments.
- Added a half-way bonus for the MARK SUITS.  The bonus is lit after the
  third MARK SUIT and awarded at the SPINNER.
- Reduced the number of WHIPLASH TARGETS needed for subsequent WHIPLASH
  MULTIBALLS from +5 hits to +1 hit, as an adjustment.
- Added a maximum number of hits for WHIPLASH, as an adjustment.
- SHIELD lanes now light S.H.I.E.L.D. (MYSTERY) after the lanes during
  JERICHO MISSILE MAYHEM have been completed.
- Added high score tables for BOGEY, IRON MAN, WAR MACHINE, IRON MONGER,

- Game over effects are terminated when entering test mode.
- Synced the knocker to run with replay/special effects.
- Renamed music and speech volume adjustments (attenuation).
- Fixed a bug that was causing the Magnet device driver to ignore the
  "disabled" adjustment.
- Fixed switches from showing up in the tech alert when they are not
  broken.  These include:
    TOURNAMENT START BUTTON
    START BUTTON
    LEFT COIN
    CENTER COIN
    RIGHT COIN
    FOURTH COIN
    FIFTH COIN
    DEDICATED #15 (NOT USED)
    TILT PENDULUM
    SLAM TILT (OPTIONAL)
    TICKET NOTCH
    TEST ESCAPE, MINUS, PLUS, ENTER
    DIP #1 - #8

  and hit either the blue or red neighbor before hitting the white target,
  then the shift skill shot would not be awarded.  The display effect now
  shows the actual number of gears awarded.

  reported bad in the tech alert.

  Mustang Multiball, Upgrade Multiball, and SilverBall Stampede Multiball

V1.60.0 - Nov. 30, 2017
=======================

  - Timers paused when the ball is in the crossbow.
  - Increased the size of the RGB LED system memory pool such that
    allocations for a larger number of simultaneous effects would not
    fail.
  - Changed ON/OFF implementation of the LEDs so they approximate the lamp
    levels.
  - Implemented the HORDE flasher.
  - Added WALKER BOMBS to instant info.
  - Added an adjustment (and increased the amount of time) for the CROSSBOW
    MOTOR switch lockout.  This adjustment specifies the amount of time to
    lock out switch activity for the crossbow to handle the case where the
    motor moves opposite the desired direction, which requires more time
    for the switches to be ignored.  This adjustment solves the problem on
    some games where the player would not be able to fire the ball after
    loading the CROSSBOW.
  - The RIGHT DROP TARGET was not waiting long enough between raise/lower
    during ball search to allow a stuck ball (behind the target) to be freed
    up.  This has been corrected.

  - The CROSSBOW mode was allowed to start during HORDE and LAST MAN
    STANDING.  This has been corrected.
  - Added dynamic stacking of background display/music for PRISON and
    WELL modes, such that the player will see/hear the backgrounds that
    correspond to the last mode that was started.
  - Changed background lamp effect priorities so more important lamps
    could be seen (i.e. CDC lamps over PRISON lamps).
  - Trough ball serve at the start of HORDE / LAST MAN STANDING was not
    being held off long enough for the ball-in-play to be cleared from the
    shooter lane.  This has been corrected.
  - LAST MAN STANDING was allowed to start during multiball (PRISON, WELL,
    BLOOD BATH) and HORDE.  This has been corrected.
  - The accessibility of the WOODBURY SKILL SHOT awards is reset when all
    of the awards have been collected.
  - Fixed a problem with the WOODBURY SKILL SHOT where none of the good
    awards would show up unless they were all lit on one ball.
  - Lowered scoring for LAST MAN STANDING.
  - Removed shot scoring cap for LAST MAN STANDING.
  - Added sounds for PRISON MULTIBALL victory laps and WELL MULTIBALL
    victory laps.
  - Fixed a bug in the auto-percentaged extra ball module that would
    sometimes set the extra ball value (walker kills) to an out of range
    value.
  - The background lamp effect for SIEGE was allowed to run when the awards
    for SIEGE were not allowed (due to other rules, e.g. HORDE, etc.).
    This has been corrected.
  - Changed the number of target bank completions to light modes for
    COMPETITION to always be 1.
  - PRISON MULTIBALL super jackpot now starts at 1M instead of 0.
  - PRISON MULTIBALL victory lap jackpot now starts at 500K instead of 0.
  - Added SIEGE status to PRISON MULTIBALL background display effect.
  - CROSSBOW scores carryover ball to ball changed from NO to YES.  This
    should help make CROSSBOW FRENZY more valuable.
  - HORDE background now renders the text over the advancing walkers.
  - Added an adjustment (default=YES) to HORDE that relights all killed
    walkers with the exception of the walker that is associated with the
    shot that was just made.
  - Fixed a bug in the HORDE mode which would cause the game to reset when
    the last walker was killed to advance to the next level.
  - 2x playfield status now displayed in the shot multiplier HSTD roll.
  - Added and adjustment to light "ESCAPE" for HORDE after a certain number
    of levels have been completed (default: 3 levels).
      - After the required number of levels have been completed, when the
        player is down to 1 ball, the WOODBURY shot is lit for ESCAPE.
      - Shooting the WOODBURY shot with ESCAPE lit allows the player to
        either continue to fight the HORDE (left flipper: FIGHT) or to ESCAPE
        the HORDE (right flipper: ESCAPE).
      - If the player chooses FIGHT, the ball is auto-launched back onto
        the playfield and the HORDE mode continues.
      - If the player chooses ESCAPE, the HORDE mode ends, a bonus is
        awarded, and the SKILL SHOT is started.
      - If the player plunges (launches) the ball back onto the playfield
        without making a choice, the HORDE mode continues.
      - Added a setting (default: OFF, competition default: ON) that pauses
        the advancement of the walkers during HORDE when the FIGHT/ESCAPE
        screen is being displayed and the game is waiting for input from
        the player.
      - Added an adjustment for losing HORDE (the walkers advanced too far
        and bit the player) to either serve a new ball (default, as before)
        or go to bonus (competition).
  - Added TOWER HITS and TOWER EXTRA BALL to instant info.
  - Increased the scoring for the ESCAPE TERMINUS mode.
  - Fixed MULTIKILL mode start display effects from showing "MULTIKILL
    VALUE 00" when the values are set to reset at HORDE start and HORDE is
    started before the MULTIKILL start display effects have had a chance
    to run.
  - Changed the update priority of the background lamp effect for the
    fire button so it will run first and not be excluded by in-game lamp
    effects that cannot run.
  - SKILL SHOT scores now rendered using the outline font.
  - Changed score type to 64-bit so scores will not roll at 4B.
  - Fixed a render-order bug in the LAST MAN STANDING background display
    effect that was causing the back right walker kill to be rendered over
    the far right walker.
  - If the player scored an 8X, 11X, 18X, or 80X-89X multiplier for the
    X champion, the prefix (A) was wrong.  This has been corrected.
  - Fixed an issue where fading the music volume would cause the music to
    cut out entirely.
  - Removed score caps for BARN, TUNNEL, and ARENA modes (shot acores are
    allowed to increase without limit).
  - BARN shot score increase per shot changed from 500k to 750k.
  - SLINGSHOT types were not baing flagged as such; this has been corrected.
  - Increased consecutive ARENA ramp shot score multiplier from x3, x4, x5,
    ... to x3, x6, x9, ...
  - TUNNEL mode scores increased by 2.5M a shot when all shots (not
    including the tunnel shot, of course) are completed and reset.
  - BARN mode switch hit increment (one for each barn shot made) increased
    from 10K to 12.5K.
  - Fixed player up effects so they wait for speech and don't end on a
    blank frame.
  - Changed previous mode scores for TUNNEL from 1M to 1.25M.
  - Tripled the scores for SIEGE.
  - Fixed a bug in the loop code that would allow multiple X shots within
    a time period.
  - WALKER KILLS minimum # lit increased from 3 to 4.
  - The "timers off" logic was not checking for HORDE or LAST MAN STANDING.
    These modes CAN be multiball, but also run with only one ball on the
    playfield (the mode does not end when the player drains down to 1 ball).
    This has been corrected.
  - Changed previous mode scores for ARENA from 250k to 500k.
  - Fixed switches from showing up in the tech alert when they are not
    broken.  These include:
        TOURNAMENT START BUTTON
        START BUTTON
        LEFT COIN
        CENTER COIN
        RIGHT COIN
        FOURTH COIN
        FIFTH COIN
        DEDICATED #6, #7, #8, #14, #16, #20 (NOT USED)
        TILT PENDULUM
        SLAM TILT (OPTIONAL)
        TICKET NOTCH
        TEST ESCAPE, MINUS, PLUS, ENTER
        DIP #1 - #8

    instead of automatically when the last multi-kill is started.

    advanced up to a distance where there are neighboring (adjacent) walkers
